title: Everyday Phrases — At the Nail Salon
title_quote: Hi, do you have an open seat right now?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💅 實用「做美甲」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Nail Salon
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「做美甲」情境對話，共 800 句、400 組短句（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。從進門問有沒有位子、翻顏色色卡挑一個，說清楚要的指甲形狀、把手泡軟、再塗第二層，到問會不會太快掉、跟美甲師聊當天的天氣，最後結帳、給小費、約好下一次，八個場景一路聽下去。每句 3 到 9 個字，A2 生活口語，不用背、不用看螢幕，躺下來循環聽 800 句就能記住。適合英語初學者、ESL 學員、想睡前複習英文的大人。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features 800 practical At the Nail Salon phrases in 400 pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). Eight scenes run in order: asking whether a seat is open, picking a color from the shade card, saying which nail shape you want, soaking the hands soft, adding the second coat, asking how fast the gel will chip, chatting about the weather with your nail tech, and paying with a tip while booking the next visit. Every line is 3 to 9 words at CEFR A2 level, so you just lie down and let the 800-sentence loop do the work. Great for beginners, ESL learners, and anyone reviewing English before bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, do you have an open seat right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ du ju hæv ən ˈoʊpən sit raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問現在還有空位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one chair by the window is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn tʃɛr baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 有的，窗邊那個位子剛好空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I only need a hand manicure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ ˈoʊnli nid ə hænd ˈmænɪˌkjʊr/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我只做手部美甲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, the window station is coming up next.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈsteɪʃən ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ ʌp nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 好，窗邊那桌美甲位一下就會輪到你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a basic gel manicure today?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈbeɪsɪk dʒɛl ˈmænɪˌkjʊr təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天可以做基礎款凝膠美甲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, that service takes about forty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðæt ˈsɝvɪs teɪks əˈbaʊt ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 可以，那項服務大約四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you seat people without a booking?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sit ˈpipəl wɪˈðaʊt ə ˈbukɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不用預約也能當場坐下來做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, unless the whole bench is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʌnˈlɛs ðə hoʊl bɛntʃ ɪz fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 可以，除非整排美甲椅都坐滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the wait this afternoon?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðə weɪt ðɪs ˌæftərˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 今天下午要等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About fifteen minutes, the next chair opens soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt fɪfˈtin ˈmɪnɪts ðə nɛkst tʃɛr ˈoʊpənz sun/
dialogue.zh: 大約十五分鐘，下一張椅子很快空出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can wait, the polish wall looks interesting.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn weɪt ðə ˈpɑlɪʃ wɔl lʊks ˈɪntəˌrɛstɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我願意等，那面指甲油牆好有意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, you can flip the color chart first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ju kæn flɪp ðə ˈkʌlɚ tʃɑrt fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 那你也可以先翻翻色卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the gel service or regular polish?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ðə dʒɛl ˈsɝvɪs ɔr ˈrɛɡjəlɚ ˈpɑlɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 這服務是凝膠，還是一般指甲油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gel needs the lamp, regular polish air dries.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒɛl nidz ðə læmp ˈrɛɡjəlɚ ˈpɑlɪʃ ɛr draɪz/
dialogue.zh: 凝膠要用烤燈，一般指甲油靠風乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one lasts longer on my nails?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn læsts ˈlɔŋɡɚ ɑn maɪ neɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 哪一種在我的指甲上撐比較久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gel holds three weeks, regular only about five days.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒɛl hoʊldz θri wikz ˈrɛɡjəlɚ ˈoʊnli əˈbaʊt faɪv deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 凝膠撐三週，一般的大約五天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gel sounds right, my nails peel so fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒɛl saʊndz raɪt maɪ neɪlz pil soʊ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 凝膠適合我，我的指甲一下就剝掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we keep the base coat a bit thicker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kip ðə beɪs koʊt ə bɪt ˈθɪkɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就把底膠塗厚一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the gel set with one accent?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə dʒɛl sɛt wɪð wʌn ˈæksɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 加一個跳色的凝膠全組多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty dollars, and one accent nail is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz ænd wʌn ˈæksɛnt neɪl ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 四十美元，一個跳色指甲不另收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old gel is still on from last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld dʒɛl ɪz stɪl ɑn frʌm læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 上個月的凝膠還在我的指甲上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we soak it off before the new coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi soʊk ɪt ɔf bɪˈfɔr ðə nu koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們先把它泡軟卸掉再上層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does removing old gel cost extra money?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz rɪˈmuvɪŋ oʊld dʒɛl kɔst ˈɛkstrə ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 卸舊凝膠要另外加錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No extra cost, the soak off is included.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈɛkstrə kɔst ðə soʊk ɔf ɪz ɪnˈkludɪd/
dialogue.zh: 不用另加錢，卸舊膠已經含在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to take off my rings first?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə teɪk ɔf maɪ rɪŋz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 我要先把戒指摘下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, place them in the small tray here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pleɪs ðɛm ɪn ðə smɔl treɪ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 要，先放在這邊的小托盤裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ring finger is swollen, can you see?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ rɪŋ ˈfɪŋɡɚ ɪz ˈsweldoʊn kæn ju si/
dialogue.zh: 我無名指有點腫，你看得出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see, I will work around that finger.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si aɪ wɪl wɜrk əˈraʊnd ðæt ˈfɪŋɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，我會避開那根手指修。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wash my hands before we start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ wɑʃ maɪ hændz bɪˈfɔr wi stɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 開始前我要先洗手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, scrub the nails, then dry on this towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs skrʌb ðə neɪlz ðɛn draɪ ɑn ðɪs ˈtaʊəl/
dialogue.zh: 要，把指甲縫搓一搓，再用毛巾擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This chair feels low, can it go up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs tʃɛr filz loʊ kæn ɪt ɡoʊ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 這椅子感覺好低，能調高一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the pedal under the table adjusts it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðə ˈpɛdl ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈteɪbəl əˈdʒʌsts ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以，桌子下面的踏板能升降。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I rest my elbows on the arm pad?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ rɛst maɪ ˈɛlboʊz ɑn ðə ɑrm pæd/
dialogue.zh: 我的手肘可以擱在墊手上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I added a clean cover just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ ˈædəd ə klin ˈkʌvər dʒʌst naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，我剛換了乾淨的墊套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your name tag says Mia, nice meeting you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr neɪm tæɡ sɛz ˈmiə naɪs ˈmitɪŋ ju/
dialogue.zh: 你名牌寫著 Mia，很高興認識你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I do gel work the best here.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks aɪ du dʒɛl wɜrk ðə bɛst hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，店裡我最擅長凝膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is ringing, may I silence it?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz ˈrɪŋɪŋ meɪ aɪ ˈsaɪləns ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我手機在響，可以讓它安靜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, set it face down on the side shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs sɛt ɪt feɪs daʊn ɑn ðə saɪd ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 好，把它面朝下放進邊上的架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the smell here from the acetone jar?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə smɛl hɪr frʌm ðə ˈæsɪton dʒɑr/
dialogue.zh: 這邊的氣味是去光水罐的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Partly, the fan runs when we open new bottles.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑrtli ðə fæn rʌnz wɛn wi ˈoʊpən nu ˈbɑtəlz/
dialogue.zh: 一半是吧，開新瓶時風扇會轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a bad cuticle on my thumb.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə bæd ˈkjutɪkəl ɑn maɪ θʌm/
dialogue.zh: 我拇指的甲皮翹得很難看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will push it back, never cut it deep.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pʊʃ ɪt bæk ˈnɛvər kʌt ɪt dip/
dialogue.zh: 我會往後推，不會剪太深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One nail is cracked near the side edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn neɪl ɪz krækt nɪr ðə saɪd ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 有一片指甲靠近邊緣裂開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glue fills small cracks, we keep them short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlul fɪlz smɔl kræks wi kip ðɛm ʃɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 膠能填補小裂縫，我們會把那片留短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nails are bitten, does that matter?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪlz ɑr ˈbɪtən dʌz ðæt ˈmætɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我的指甲被我自己咬短了，有關係嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely, short nails still take color well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛrli ʃɔrt neɪlz stɪl teɪk ˈkʌlɚ wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 幾乎不影響，短指甲一樣很吃色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Acrylic tips, do you put those on here?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈkrɪlɪk tɪps du ju pʊt ðoʊz ɑn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 延長用的壓克力片，你們店裡做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only gel here, acrylic needs a bigger drill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli dʒɛl hɪr əˈkrɪlɪk nidz ə ˈbɪɡɚ drɪl/
dialogue.zh: 這裡只做凝膠，壓克力要用大磨機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a nail drill loud for everyone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə neɪl drɪl laʊd fɚ ˈɛvriˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 磨甲機是不是對誰都很吵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hums softly, I only use it on tips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hʌmz ˈsɔftli aɪ ˈoʊnli juz ɪt ɑn tɪps/
dialogue.zh: 它只輕輕嗡嗡叫，我僅用在指尖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are dry in this weather, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz ɑr draɪ ɪn ðɪs ˈwɛðɚ ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 這種天氣我的手好乾，不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, cream comes after the top coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm krim kʌmz ˈæftɚ ðə tɑp koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，護手霜會最後再擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you busy today or is it quiet?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈbɪzi təˈdeɪ ɔr ɪz ɪt ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 今天店裡忙嗎，還是很空？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet now, Saturday before the holiday fills up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət naʊ ˈsætɚˌdeɪ bɪˈfɔr ðə ˈhɑləˌdeɪ fɪlz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 現在很安靜，連假前的週六會爆滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many sets do you do in a day?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni sɛts du ju du ɪn ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你一天大概做幾組指甲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around six, each full set takes an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd sɪks itʃ fʊl sɛt teɪks ɑn ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 大約六組，一組完整要做一個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An hour for both hands, that is quick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈaʊər fɚ boʊθ hændz ðæt ɪz kwɪk/
dialogue.zh: 一小時做兩手，還算快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Faster if you sit still during the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæstɚ ɪf ju sɪt stɪl ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə læmp/
dialogue.zh: 你在烤燈時不動，我就會更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will keep still under the lamp, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip stɪl ˈʌndɚ ðə læmp ˈprɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 烤燈的時候我不會動，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, moving smudges the wet polish layer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmuvɪŋ ˈsmʌdʒɪz ðə wɛt ˈpɑlɪʃ ˈleɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，亂動會把沒乾的指甲油弄糊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep the color chart books?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ju kip ðə ˈkʌlɚ tʃɑrt bʊks/
dialogue.zh: 色卡本收在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third shelf, the new shades are on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd ʃɛlf ðə nu ʃeɪdz ɑr ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 第三層架子，新色都擺在最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I hold the chart while you clean up?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ hoʊld ðə tʃɑrt waɪl ju klin ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 你整理的時候我可以先拿色卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, wipe the nails first so color shows true.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr waɪp ðə neɪlz fɜrst soʊ ˈkʌlɚ ʃoʊz tru/
dialogue.zh: 好，先擦過甲面，顏色才準確。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every polish bottle has a number, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈpɑlɪʃ ˈbɑtəl hæz ə ˈnʌmbɚ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 每瓶指甲油都有編號，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, number forty two is that dusty rose.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈnʌmbɚ ˈfɔrti tu ɪz ðæt ˈdʌsti roʊz/
dialogue.zh: 有，四十二號就是那個霧面玫瑰色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which hand should we paint first today?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ hænd ʃʊd wi peɪnt fɜrst təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天先塗哪一手？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right hand first, the gel dries evenly there.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hænd fɜrst ðə dʒɛl draɪz ˈivənli ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 先做右手，那側凝膠較容易乾得勻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My right thumb always smudges the design.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ raɪt θʌm ˈɔlweɪz ˈsmʌdʒɪz ðə dɪˈzaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我右手拇指總是把圖案弄糊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we cure that nail alone under the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kjʊr ðæt neɪl əˈloʊn ˈʌndɚ ðə læmp/
dialogue.zh: 那就在燈下單獨烤那一根。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Curing sounds serious, is it hot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkjʊrɪŋ saʊndz ˈsɪriəs ɪz ɪt hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 烤聽起來很正式，會燙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Briefly warm, that is the gel setting hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbrifli wɔrm ðæt ɪz ðə dʒɛl ˈsɛtɪŋ hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 一下下微溫，那是凝膠正在變硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do my fingers stay in there?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du maɪ ˈfɪŋɡɚz steɪ ɪn ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我的手要在燈裡待多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty seconds for each thin coat of gel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti ˈsɛkəndz fɚ itʃ θɪn koʊt ɑv dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 每一層薄凝膠烤六十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right away, or should I wait for the beep?
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt əˈweɪ ɔr ʃʊd aɪ weɪt fɚ ðə bip/
dialogue.zh: 馬上拿出來，還是等嗶一聲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait for the beep, then pull it slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt fɚ ðə bip ðɛn pʊl ɪt ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 等嗶一聲，再慢慢把手抽出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The beep means the lamp timer finished, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bip minz ðə læmp ˈtaɪmɚ ˈfɪnɪʃt raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗶一聲代表烤燈時間到了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, do not touch the nail plate then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli du nɑt tʌtʃ ðə neɪl pleɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那時候別碰到甲面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This table pad is soft for my wrist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈteɪbəl pæd ɪz sɔft fɚ maɪ rɪst/
dialogue.zh: 桌上這個墊對手腕好舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep two pads, use the thicker one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip tu pædz juz ðə ˈθɪkɚ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我準備兩個墊，你壓厚的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring my own nail file next time?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ maɪ oʊn neɪl faɪl nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 下次我該自己帶挫條嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, I give you a disposable one.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ nid aɪ ɡɪv ju ə ˌdɪsəˈpɛzəbl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 不用，我會給你一條免洗挫條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a manicure here good for men too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə ˈmænɪˌkjʊr hɪr ɡʊd fɚ mɛn tu/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡做美甲也適合男生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, clean short nails suit everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs klin ʃɔrt neɪlz sut ˈɛvriˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 當然，乾淨的短指甲適合每一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only want the nails neat, not colorful.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊnli wɑnt ðə neɪlz nit nɑt ˈkʌlɚfəl/
dialogue.zh: 我只想把指甲弄整齊，不要鮮豔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a clear coat over a nude shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə klɪr koʊt ˈoʊvɚ ə nud ʃeɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那就上一層透明膠配裸色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nude means close to my own nail color?
dialogue.phonetic: /nud minz kloʊs tə maɪ oʊn neɪl ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 裸色就是接近我原本的指甲色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a soft pink beige that reads clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə sɔft pɪŋk beɪʒ ðæt ridz klin/
dialogue.zh: 對，偏粉的米色，看起來乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quick touch up between visits, is that possible?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kwɪk tʌtʃ ʌp bɪˈtwin ˈvɪzɪts ɪz ðæt ˈpɑsəbl/
dialogue.zh: 兩次之間來個快速補色，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, only the grown out roots get filled.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈoʊnli ðə groʊn aʊt ruts ɡɛt fɪld/
dialogue.zh: 可以，只補長出來的那段根部。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, my gel always grows out ugly here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt maɪ dʒɛl ˈɔlweɪz ɡroʊz aʊt ˈʌɡli hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的凝膠在這裡總長得難看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three weeks is the normal refill window.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri wikz ɪz ðə ˈnɔrməl ˌriˈfɪl ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 三週是補膠的標準間隔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Refill means I keep the same color again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌriˈfɪl minz aɪ kip ðə seɪm ˈkʌlɚ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 補膠就是繼續用同一個顏色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people switch shades, it is up to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl swɪtʃ ʃeɪdz ɪt ɪz ʌp tə ju/
dialogue.zh: 多數人會換色，這由你決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's start with the color chart, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts stɑrt wɪð ðə ˈkʌlɚ tʃɑrt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我們先從色卡開始，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is the big book, start on page ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ðə bɪɡ bʊk stɑrt ɑn peɪdʒ tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 這本是全本，你先翻到第十頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each page shows two strips of the same gel.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ peɪdʒ ʃoʊz tu strɪps ɑv ðə seɪm dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 每一頁都有兩條同樣的凝膠色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One strip shows one coat, one shows two.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn strɪp ʃoʊz wʌn koʊt wʌn ʃoʊz tu/
dialogue.zh: 一條是塗一層，一條是塗兩層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is useful, the single coat looks thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈjusfəl ðə ˈsɪŋɡəl koʊt lʊks θɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這有用，一層看起來好薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two coats make the shade look real.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu koʊts meɪk ðə ʃeɪd lʊk ril/
dialogue.zh: 兩層才看得出真正的色澤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So many shades, I cannot choose anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈmɛni ʃeɪdz aɪ ˈkɑnɑt tʃuz ˈɛniθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 色號這麼多，我完全選不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with a family, warm or cool tones.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪð ə ˈfæməli wɔrm ɔr kul toʊnz/
dialogue.zh: 先挑色系，暖色調還是冷色調。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool sounds good, my skin leans pink.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul saʊndz ɡʊd maɪ skɪn linz pɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 冷色不錯，我的膚色偏粉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then mauve and gray blue sit well on you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn mɔv ænd ɡreɪ blu sɪt wɛl ɑn ju/
dialogue.zh: 那灰紫和灰藍在你手上會很好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mauve is that faded purple on page four?
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔv ɪz ðæt ˈfeɪdɪd ˈpɜrpəl ɑn peɪdʒ fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 灰紫是第四頁那個退色的紫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it looks like a dry rose petal.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt lʊks laɪk ə draɪ roʊz ˈpɛtəl/
dialogue.zh: 對，它像乾掉的玫瑰花瓣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page ten has too many beige options.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ tɛn hæz tu ˈmɛni beɪʒ ˈɑpʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 第十頁的米色選項太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beige is tricky, hold it near your own nail.
dialogue.phonetic: /beɪʒ ɪz ˈtrɪki hoʊld ɪt nɪr jʊr oʊn neɪl/
dialogue.zh: 米色很難挑，拿到指甲旁邊比較。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one matches, it blends with my nail bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ˈmætʃɪz ɪt blɛnz wɪð maɪ neɪl bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 這條很合，跟我的甲床融在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the nude you want for the office.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə nud ju wɑnt fɚ ðə ˈɔfɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那就是你要的辦公室裸色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Office safe, but I want a little fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔfɪs seɪf bʌt aɪ wɑnt ə ˈlɪtəl fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 能進辦公室，但我想帶點趣味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add one glitter accent on the ring finger.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd wʌn ˈɡlɪtɚ ˈæksɛnt ɑn ðə rɪŋ ˈfɪŋɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 在無名指加一個亮片跳色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glitter only on one nail, not all ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡlɪtɚ ˈoʊnli ɑn wʌn neɪl nɑt ɔl tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 亮片只上一個指甲，不要十根全上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, the accent breaks up the plain color.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðə ˈæksɛnt breɪks ʌp ðə pleɪn ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，跳色會打破平淡的底色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which strip is the softest sparkle?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ strɪp ɪz ðə ˈsɔftəst ˈspɑrkəl/
dialogue.zh: 哪一條的閃度最柔和？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That silver one, it reads like fine sugar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈsɪlvɚ wʌn ɪt ridz laɪk faɪn ˈʃʊɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那條銀色的，看起來像細砂糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sugar sounds cute, does it feel rough?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɡɚ saʊndz kjut dʌz ɪt fil rʌf/
dialogue.zh: 像砂糖一定很可愛，摸起來粗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the top coat smooths the whole surface.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə tɑp koʊt smuðz ðə hoʊl ˈsɝfəs/
dialogue.zh: 不粗，封層會把表面磨平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, rough gel snags my sweater.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd rʌf dʒɛl snæɡz maɪ ˈswɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那好，粗糙的凝膠會勾到毛衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then skip chunky glitter, use the fine one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn skɪp ˈtʃʌki ˈɡlɪtɚ juz ðə faɪn wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那就別用粗亮片，選細的那一款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine glitter it is, page twelve, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ˈɡlɪtɚ ɪt ɪz peɪdʒ twɛlv raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 就細亮片，第十二頁對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve, number six, the tiny silver dots.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈnʌmbɚ sɪks ðə ˈtaɪni ˈsɪlvɚ dɑts/
dialogue.zh: 十二頁六號，就是那些小銀點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your plastic tip samples show a lighter color.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈplæstɪk tɪp ˈsæmpəlz ʃoʊ ə ˈlaɪtər ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 塑膠假指甲上的樣色比較淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, your real nail plate darkens every shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru jʊr ril neɪl pleɪt ˈdɑrkənz ˈɛvri ʃeɪd/
dialogue.zh: 是的，你真指甲的甲面會讓色變深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So should I expect a deeper red than this?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʃʊd aɪ ɪkˈspɛkt ə ˈdipɪr rɛd ðæn ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 所以我塗出來的紅會比這條深？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, paint one nail and see in daylight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs peɪnt wʌn neɪl ænd si ɪn ˈdeɪˌlaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，先塗一根，到日光下看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Daylight helps, the lamp makes everything orange.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪˌlaɪt hɛlps ðə læmp meɪks ˈɛvriθɪŋ ˈɔrɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 日光有幫助，桌上那盞燈把一切都變橘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move to the window, hold the chart up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv tə ðə ˈwɪndoʊ hoʊld ðə tʃɑrt ʌp ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 移到窗邊，在亮處舉起色卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that cherry red is much stronger now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt ˈtʃɛri rɛd ɪz mʌtʃ ˈstrɔŋɡɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，那個櫻桃紅現在看起來強多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cherry needs two thin coats to look even.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɛri nidz tu θɪn koʊts tə lʊk ˈivən/
dialogue.zh: 櫻桃紅要兩層薄塗才均勻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two coats is fine, I planned that anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu koʊts ɪz faɪn aɪ plænd ðæt ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 兩層沒問題，我本來就這麼打算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, dark shades always need a second layer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd dɑrk ʃeɪdz ˈɔlweɪz nid ə ˈsɛkənd ˈleɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，深色的凝膠總是要第二層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the milky white on page nine?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmɪki waɪt ɑn peɪdʒ naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那第九頁的奶白色怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milky white shows every smudge, honest warning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪki waɪt ʃoʊz ˈɛvri smʌdʒ ˈɑnɪst ˈwɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 奶白會浮出每個指印，實話提醒你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for warning me, my nails hit everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ ˈwɔrnɪŋ mi maɪ neɪlz hɪt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝提醒，我的指甲會碰到所有東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then choose a shade that hides small marks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃuz ə ʃeɪd ðæt haɪdz smɔl mɑrks/
dialogue.zh: 那就選會蓋掉小痕跡的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hiding marks matters more than the perfect color.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhaɪdɪŋ mɑrks ˈmætɚz mɔr ðæn ðə ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 蓋住痕跡比完美顏色更重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try dusty rose, it forgives almost everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ˈdʌsti roʊz ɪt fɚˈɡivz ˈɔlmoʊst ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 試試霧面玫瑰，它幾乎什麼都能遮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dusty rose again, that is number forty two?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʌsti roʊz əˈɡɛn ðæt ɪz ˈnʌmbɚ ˈfɔrti tu/
dialogue.zh: 又是霧面玫瑰，那是四十二號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same family, but forty four has more gray.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈfæməli bʌt ˈfɔrti fɔr hæz mɔr ɡreɪ/
dialogue.zh: 同色系，但四十四號灰味更重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More gray looks better with my work shirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr ɡreɪ lʊks ˈbɛtɚ wɪð maɪ wɜrk ʃɝts/
dialogue.zh: 帶灰的跟我工作襯衫比較搭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then forty four, I will note it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈfɔrti fɔr aɪ wɪl noʊt ɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 那就四十四號，我幫你寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noting helps, I always forget the shade name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪŋ hɛlps aɪ ˈɔlweɪz fɚˈɡɛt ðə ʃeɪd neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 寫下來有幫助，我老是忘記色名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Names change, the number stays the same forever.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪmz tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈnʌmbɚ steɪz ðə seɪm fɚˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 色名會改，編號永遠是一樣的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forever is nice, my hands stay in one color.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚˈɛvɚ ɪz naɪs maɪ hændz steɪ ɪn wʌn ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 永遠相同剛好，我的手可一直同一色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most clients switch every two or three visits.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈklaɪənts swɪtʃ ˈɛvri tu ɔr θri ˈvɪzɪts/
dialogue.zh: 多數客人來兩三次就換色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Switching tempts me, this emerald is beautiful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈswɪtʃɪŋ tɛmpts mi ðɪs ˈɛmərəld ɪz ˈbjutəfəl/
dialogue.zh: 換色也在勾引我，這翡翠色真美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Emerald suits winter, the gel stays deep green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmərəld suts ˈwɪntɛr ðə dʒɛl steɪz dip ɡrin/
dialogue.zh: 翡翠色適合冬天，凝膠會保持深綠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Winter greens need a glossy top, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪntɛr ɡrinz nid ə ˈɡlɑsi tɑp aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 冬天的綠色我想需要亮面封層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glossy yes, matte green can look chalky here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡlɑsi jɛs mæt ɡrin kæn lʊk ˈtʃɔki hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 亮面對，霧面綠在燈下像粉筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chalky is exactly what I want to avoid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɔki ɪz ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt aɪ wɑnt tə əˈvɔɪd/
dialogue.zh: 粉筆感正是我要避開的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then two glossy coats and a shiny seal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tu ˈɡlɑsi koʊts ænd ə ˈʃaɪni sil/
dialogue.zh: 那就亮面兩層，再加一道光封膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A shiny seal sounds like the top coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈʃaɪni sil saʊndz laɪk ðə tɑp koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 發亮的封膠聽起來就是封層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the seal keeps the green from fading out.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə sil kips ðə ɡrin frʌm ˈfeɪdɪŋ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 對，封層會讓綠色不那麼快淡掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fading near the tip bothers me the most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfeɪdɪŋ nɪr ðə tɪp ˈbɑdɚz mi ðə moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 指尖那邊先退色最讓我在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrap the tip edge with extra polish.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ræp ðə tɪp ɛdʒ wɪð ˈɛkstrə ˈpɑlɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我會沿指尖邊緣多包一點油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrapping the edge, that is the salon trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈræpɪŋ ðə ɛdʒ ðæt ɪz ðə səˈlɑn trɪk/
dialogue.zh: 包邊就是美甲店的祕訣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, it buys another week of wear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪt baɪz əˈnʌðɚ wik ʌv wɛr/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那能多撐一週不掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Another week of wear, that sells it to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈnʌðɚ wik ʌv wɛr ðæt sɛlz ɪt tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 多撐一週，這點就說服我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green decided, now choose something for accents.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin dɪˈsaɪdəd naʊ tʃuz ˈsʌmθɪŋ fɚ ˈæksɛnts/
dialogue.zh: 綠色定了，接著挑跳色要什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Accent ideas, do you do thin gold lines?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæksɛnt aɪˈdiz du ju du θɪn ɡoʊld laɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 跳色點子，你們會畫細金線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a single gold line on the index nail.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ɡoʊld laɪn ɑn ði ˈɪndɛks neɪl/
dialogue.zh: 會，食指那片畫一條金線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A gold line plus glitter, is that too much?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡoʊld laɪn plʌs ˈɡlɪtɚ ɪz ðæt tu mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 金線再加亮片，會不會太誇張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One feature per nail, that keeps it clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈfitʃɚ pɚ neɪl ðæt kips ɪt klin/
dialogue.zh: 一片指甲一個重點，才不會亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One feature per nail, I will remember that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈfitʃɚ pɚ neɪl aɪ wɪl rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 一片一個重點，我記住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on your phone, next time you forget.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt ɑn jʊr foʊn nɛkst taɪm ju fɚˈɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 記到手機裡，不然下次你又忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forgetting happens, I brought a wrong photo last time.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈhæpənz aɪ brɔt ə rɔŋ ˈfoʊtoʊ læst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 會忘的，上次我帶錯顏色照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photos shift colors, this chart is honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz ʃɪft ˈkʌlɚz ðɪs tʃɑrt ɪz ˈɑnɪst/
dialogue.zh: 照片會跑色，這本色卡才誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honest chart, honest mirror, my nails look pale.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnɪst tʃɑrt ˈɑnɪst ˈmɪrər maɪ neɪlz lʊk peɪl/
dialogue.zh: 誠實的色卡，誠實的鏡子，我指甲好白。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pale nails make bright shades pop more.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪl neɪlz meɪk braɪt ʃeɪdz pɑp mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 淡指甲會讓鮮色跳得更明顯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pop more means coral instead of that beige?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑp mɔr minz ˈkɔrəl ɪnˈstɛd ɑv ðæt beɪʒ/
dialogue.zh: 更跳的意思是選珊瑚色取代米色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coral is fun and hides the grow out line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔrəl ɪz fʌn ænd haɪdz ðə ɡroʊ aʊt laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 珊瑚色有趣，也能藏長出來的線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The grow out line, that is my biggest problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡroʊ aʊt laɪn ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈbɪɡɪst ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 長出來那條線，是我最大的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deep shades hide it, pale ones show it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /dip ʃeɪdz haɪd ɪt peɪl wʌnz ʃoʊ ɪt fæst/
dialogue.zh: 深色藏得住，淡色一下就看穿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deep shades it is, maybe the emerald after all.
dialogue.phonetic: /dip ʃeɪdz ɪt ɪz ˈmeɪbi ði ˈɛmərəld ˈæftɚ ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 那就選深色，最後可能還是翡翠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Emerald plus one silver accent, very you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmərəld plʌs wʌn ˈsɪlvɚ ˈæksɛnt ˈvɛri ju/
dialogue.zh: 翡翠綠加一片銀色跳色，很像你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very me, that makes me laugh out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri mi ðæt meɪks mi læf aʊt laʊd/
dialogue.zh: 真的很我，我笑出聲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Laughing moves your hands, hold the pad tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlæfɪŋ muvz jʊr hændz hoʊld ðə pæd taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一笑手就動，壓好桌墊別晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, the chart slips when I giggle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri ðə tʃɑrt slɪps wɛn aɪ ˈɡɪɡəl/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我一忍不住笑色卡就滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set the chart flat on the table, it slips.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə tʃɑrt flæt ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl ɪt slɪps/
dialogue.zh: 把色卡平攤在桌上，它會滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flat on the table, now show me the reds.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl naʊ ʃoʊ mi ðə rɛdz/
dialogue.zh: 平放在桌上，現在給我看紅色區。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page twenty holds every red, warm and cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ ˈtwɛnti hoʊldz ˈɛvri rɛd wɔrm ɔr kul/
dialogue.zh: 第二十頁收著所有紅，暖的冷的都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty is thick, my thumb cannot open it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ɪz θɪk maɪ θʌm ˈkɑnɑt ˈoʊpən ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 第二十頁好厚，我拇指翻不開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, I support the book, you point at one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr aɪ səˈpɔrt ðə bʊk ju pɔɪnt æt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 來，我扶住色卡本，你指一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That brick red, the third one from the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt brɪk rɛd ðə θɜrd wʌn frʌm ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 那條磚紅，從左邊來第三條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good eye, brick red photographs richer than black.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ brɪk rɛd ˈfoʊtəˌɡræfs ˈrɪtʃɚ ðæn blæk/
dialogue.zh: 眼力好，磚紅拍照比黑色有質感。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photographs matter, my sister wants close up shots.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtəˌɡræfs ˈmætɚ maɪ ˈsɪstɚ wɑnts kloʊs ʌp ʃɑts/
dialogue.zh: 拍照很重要，我姊要拍指甲特寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close ups love gloss, matte looks flat on camera.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊs ʌps lʌv ɡlɑs mæt lʊks flæt ɑn ˈkæmɚə/
dialogue.zh: 特寫適合亮面，霧面上鏡會扁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Camera test settled, brick red and a glossy top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæmɚə tɛst ˈsɛtəld brɪk rɛd ænd ə ˈɡlɑsi tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 拍照這關過了，磚紅配亮面封層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will swatch it on your pinky first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ wɪl swɑtʃ ɪt ɑn jʊr ˈpɪŋki fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 好，我先在小指上試塗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pinky first is smart, it does the least work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɪŋki fɜrst ɪz smɑrt ɪt dʊz ðə list wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 先試小指很聰明，它出力最少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, the pinky shows the true color quietly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðə ˈpɪŋki ʃoʊz ðə tru ˈkʌlɚ ˈkwaɪətli/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，小指能安靜顯示真實色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quietly tested, if it is wrong we wipe it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪətli ˈtɛstɪd ɪf ɪt ɪz rɔŋ wi waɪp ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 安靜地試，不對的話我們擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One wipe with alcohol, no damage to the plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn waɪp wɪð ˈæləˌkɔl noʊ ˈdæmɪdʒ tə ðə pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 用酒精一擦就好，不傷甲面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No damage, that relaxes me a lot today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈdæmɪdʒ ðæt rɪˈlæksɪz mi ə lɑt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不傷甲面，我今天放心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax, the brick shade already looks right on you.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈlæks ðə brɪk ʃeɪd ɔlˈrɛdi lʊks raɪt ɑn ju/
dialogue.zh: 放鬆，磚紅已經很合你的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It does look right, I am sold now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʊz lʊk raɪt aɪ æm soʊld naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 真的很合，我決定要磚紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sold, page twenty, number seven, official now.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld peɪdʒ ˈtwɛnti ˈnʌmbɚ ˈsɛvən əˈfɪʃəl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 定了，二十頁七號，正式選完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Number seven recorded, what about the shape now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbɚ ˈsɛvən rɪˈkɔrdəd wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ʃeɪp naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 七號記好了，那形狀怎麼說？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shapes next, let me look at your nail beds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪps nɛkst lɛt mi lʊk æt jʊr neɪl bɛdz/
dialogue.zh: 接著處理形狀，讓我看看你的甲床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What shapes can you actually do here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃeɪps kæn ju ˈæktʃuəli du hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 你們實際能做哪幾種指甲形狀？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round, square, oval, almond, and squoval.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd skwɛr ˈovəl ˈɑlənd ænd skwɔvəl/
dialogue.zh: 圓形、方形、橢圓、杏仁，還有方圓形。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Squoval sounds like a made up word.
dialogue.phonetic: /skwɔvəl saʊndz laɪk ə meɪd ʌp wɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 方圓形聽起來像自創的詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is square with soft rounded corners.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz skwɛr wɪð sɔft ˈraʊndɪd ˈkɔrnɚz/
dialogue.zh: 就是方形但四角磨得圓圓的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft corners suit me, my hands are small.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft ˈkɔrnɚz sut mi maɪ hændz ɑr smɔl/
dialogue.zh: 圓角適合我，我的手很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small hands look neat with a short oval.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl hændz lʊk nit wɪð ə ʃɔrt ˈovəl/
dialogue.zh: 小手配短橢圓看起來很整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oval is classic, but does it lengthen fingers?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈovəl ɪz ˈklæsɪk bʌt dʊz ɪt ˈlɛŋθən ˈfɪŋɡɚz/
dialogue.zh: 橢圓很經典，但會讓手指顯長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, oval draws the eye down each nail.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈovəl drɔz ðə aɪ daʊn itʃ neɪl/
dialogue.zh: 會，橢圓讓視線順著每片指甲往下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almond shape is on every photo online.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑlənd ʃeɪp ɪz ɑn ˈɛvri ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌɑnˈlaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 網路上的照片都是杏仁形。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almond needs length, your nails are cut short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑlənd nidz lɛŋθ jʊr neɪlz ɑr kʌt ʃɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 杏仁形要留長度，你的指甲剪很短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut short is my style, I type all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ʃɔrt ɪz maɪ staɪl aɪ taɪp ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 短指甲才是我的風格，我整天打字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Typing loves squoval, the tips stay strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪpɪŋ lʌvz skwɔvəl ðə tɪps steɪ strɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 打字最配方圓形，指尖比較不會斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Square tips click loudly on the keyboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /skwɛr tɪps klɪk ˈlaʊdli ɑn ðə ˈkiˌbɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 方形指尖敲鍵盤聲音很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, rounded ends soften the tapping sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru ˈraʊndɪd ɛndz ˈsɔfən ðə ˈtæpɪŋ saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，圓的指尖敲起來比較柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soften the sound, that is a real benefit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔfən ðə saʊnd ðæt ɪz ə ril ˈbɛnɪfɪt/
dialogue.zh: 讓聲音變柔，這好處很實際。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also, square edges snag on your hair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ skwɛr ˈɛdʒɪz snæɡ ɑn jʊr hɛr/
dialogue.zh: 而且方形邊緣會勾到你的頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snagging hair drove me crazy last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsnæɡɪŋ hɛr droʊv mi ˈkreɪzi læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 上個月一直被頭髮勾到我抓狂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then no sharp corners, I file them off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn noʊ ʃɑrp ˈkɔrnɚz aɪ faɪl ðɛm ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 那就不要尖角，我用挫條磨掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Filing now, or after the soak?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfaɪlɪŋ naʊ ɔr ˈæftɚ ðə soʊk/
dialogue.zh: 現在就挫，還是泡軟以後再挫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: File first, dry nails cut clean, no splitting.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪl fɜrst draɪ neɪlz kʌt klin noʊ ˈsplɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 先挫，乾指甲挫得乾淨，不會開裂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Splitting scares me, my left nail already cracks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsplɪtɪŋ skɛrz mi maɪ lɛft neɪl ɔlˈrɛdi kræks/
dialogue.zh: 裂開讓我很怕，左手那片已經有裂紋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see the line, we keep that thumb shorter.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ðə laɪn wi kip ðæt θʌm ˈʃɔrtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我看到裂線了，那片拇指要留更短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shorter thumb, the rest stay a bit longer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃɔrtɚ θʌm ðə rɛst steɪ ə bɪt ˈlɔŋɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 拇指短一點，其他就留長一些？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nails grow uneven, matching length takes months.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪlz ɡroʊ ʌnˈivən ˈmætʃɪŋ lɛŋθ teɪks mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 指甲長得不一樣，想修齊要等好幾個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Months of waiting, so what do we do today?
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌnθs ʌv ˈweɪtɪŋ soʊ wʌt du wi du təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 要等幾個月，那今天怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We shape what you have, even curve on each.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ʃeɪp wʌt ju hæv ˈivən kɝv ɑn itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 就照你現在的長度修，每片弧度一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even curve on each, that sounds hard to do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən kɝv ɑn itʃ ðæt saʊndz hɑrd tə du/
dialogue.zh: 每片弧度要一致，聽起來很難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I check against your pinky as the model.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʃɛk əˈɡɛnst jʊr ˈpɪŋki æz ðə ˈmɑdəl/
dialogue.zh: 我拿你的小指當基準去比。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pinky as the model, the others follow it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɪŋki æz ðə ˈmɑdəl ði ˈʌðɚz ˈfɑloʊ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 用小指當基準，其他根跟著它修？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually, small nails set the safest shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli smɔl neɪlz sɛt ðə ˈseɪfəst ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 通常如此，小指甲決定最穩的形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safest shape, that matters at my job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈseɪfəst ʃeɪp ðæt ˈmætɚz æt maɪ dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 最穩的形狀，這在我工作上很重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You handle boxes, so keep the free edge short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈhændəl ˈbɑksɪz soʊ kip ðə fri ɛdʒ ʃɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 你要搬箱子，所以指尖白邊要留短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free edge is the white part, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ɛdʒ ɪz ðə waɪt pɑrt raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 白邊就是離甲床那段白色的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, the part with no nail bed under it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðə pɑrt wɪð noʊ neɪl bɛd ˈʌndɚ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，就是下面沒有甲床撐的那段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No bed under it, so it breaks easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bɛd ˈʌndɚ ɪt soʊ ɪt breɪks ˈizəli/
dialogue.zh: 沒有甲床撐，所以很容易斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long free edges snap, short ones just bend.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ fri ˈɛdʒɪz snæp ʃɔrt wʌnz dʒʌst bɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 白邊太長會啪一聲斷，短的是彎一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bending beats snapping, please keep them short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛndɪŋ bits ˈsnæpɪŋ pliz kip ðɛm ʃɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 會彎總比會斷好，請幫我修短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One thin line of white, nothing more.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪn laɪn ʌv waɪt ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 就留一條細細的白邊，不能再多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One line is enough, I trust your judgment.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn ɪz ɪˈnʌf aɪ trʌst jʊr ˈdʒʌdʒmənt/
dialogue.zh: 一條就夠了，我信任你的判斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Judgment comes from doing this nine years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒʌdʒmənt kʌmz frʌm ˈduɪŋ ðɪs naɪn jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 這種判斷來自做了九年美甲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine years, that explains the steady hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn jɪrz ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ðə ˈstɛdi hænd/
dialogue.zh: 九年，難怪你手這麼穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steady helps when I round the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɛdi hɛlps wɛn aɪ raʊnd ðə ˈkɔrnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 手穩的時候，修圓角才不會切過頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round the corner slowly, no jagged edge please.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd ðə ˈkɔrnɚ ˈsloʊli noʊ ˈdʒæɡɪd ɛdʒ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 圓角慢慢修，請不要鋸齒狀的邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I file one direction, sawing makes ridges.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ faɪl wʌn dəˈrɛkʃən ˈsɔɪɪŋ meɪks ˈrɪdʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我都朝同一個方向挫，來回挫會起稜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ridges snag on gloves, that is annoying.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪdʒɪz snæɡ ɑn ɡlʌvz ðæt ɪz əˈnɔɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 起稜會勾到手套，那很煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The buffer smooths them before any polish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbʌfɚ smuðz ðɛm bɪˈfɔr ˈɛni ˈpɑlɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 上指甲油前我會用拋光塊磨平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buffing makes the surface flat and clean?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌfɪŋ meɪks ðə ˈsɝfəs flæt ænd klin/
dialogue.zh: 拋光是讓甲面平又乾淨？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lightly only, thick buffing thins the plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlaɪtli ˈoʊnli θɪk ˈbʌfɪŋ θɪnz ðə pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只輕輕磨，磨太厚甲面會變薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thinning the plate is my fear, go gentle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɪnɪŋ ðə pleɪt ɪz maɪ fɪr ɡoʊ ˈdʒɛntəl/
dialogue.zh: 甲面變薄是我的恐懼，輕一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gentle is my default, three passes maximum.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɛntəl ɪz maɪ dɪˈfɔlt θri ˈpæsɪz ˈmæksəməm/
dialogue.zh: 我預設就是輕手，最多磨三下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three passes, that is quick, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈpæsɪz ðæt ɪz kwɪk θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 磨三下，很快，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the thumb, it wants a wider square.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə θʌm ɪt wɑnts ə ˈwaɪdɚ skwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 現在換拇指，它適合寬一點的方形。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wider square on the thumb, why is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwaɪdɚ skwɛr ɑn ðə θʌm waɪ ɪz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 拇指要寬一點的方形，為什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thumbs are broad, pointed shapes look odd.
dialogue.phonetic: /θʌmz ɑr brɔd ˈpɔɪntɪd ʃeɪps lʊk ɑd/
dialogue.zh: 拇指本來就寬，尖的形狀會很怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pointed shapes, the stiletto ones, no thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɔɪntɪd ʃeɪps ðə stɪˈlɛtoʊ wʌnz noʊ θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 尖形就是匕首甲，那不要，謝絕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, stiletto needs thick artificial tips.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid stɪˈlɛtoʊ nidz θɪk ˌɑrtəˈfɪʃəl tɪps/
dialogue.zh: 我也同意，匕首甲要加厚的假指尖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Artificial tips are not for me at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɑrtəˈfɪʃəl tɪps ɑr nɑt fɚ mi æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 假指尖完全不適合我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then natural nails, shaped, colored, nothing added.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈnætʃərəl neɪlz ʃeɪpt ˈkʌlɚd ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈædəd/
dialogue.zh: 那就留自己指甲，修形上色，不加東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing added, exactly what I asked for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈædəd ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt aɪ æskt fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 什麼都不加，正是我要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You asked for neat, I heard practical.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju æskt fɚ nit aɪ hɜrd ˈpræktɪkəl/
dialogue.zh: 你要的是整齊，我聽到的是務實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Practical is my love language here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpræktɪkəl ɪz maɪ lʌv ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡務實就是我最愛的語言。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Practical shapes hold two more weeks of wear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpræktɪkəl ʃeɪps hoʊld tu mɔr wikz ʌv wɛr/
dialogue.zh: 務實的形狀能多撐兩週不掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more weeks, so shape affects the gel?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr wikz soʊ ʃeɪp əˈfɛkts ðə dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 多兩週，所以形狀會影響凝膠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sharp corners lift first, round ones hold.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃɑrp ˈkɔrnɚz lɪft fɜrst raʊnd wʌnz hoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 會，尖角先翹起來，圓角比較黏得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lifting corners, that is my usual failure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪftɪŋ ˈkɔrnɚz ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈjuʒuəl ˈfeɪljɚ/
dialogue.zh: 角邊翹起來，這是我常出的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we polish slightly under the free edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi ˈpɑlɪʃ ˈslaɪtli ˈʌndɚ ðə fri ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就把油稍微塗到白邊下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the edge seals it, I remember now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ði ɛdʒ silz ɪt aɪ rɪˈmɛmbɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 塗過邊下面就能封住，我想起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You learn fast, most people never ask.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lɜrn fæst moʊst ˈpipəl ˈnɛvər æsk/
dialogue.zh: 你學得快，多數人根本不會問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Asking is half the service for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæskɪŋ ɪz hæf ðə ˈsɝvɪs fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 對我來說，問就等於一半的服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Asking helps, silent hands keep the chips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæskɪŋ hɛlps ˈsaɪlənt hændz kip ðə tʃɪps/
dialogue.zh: 問有幫助，不說的人只會留缺口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chips are tiny disasters on a square tip.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪps ɑr ˈtaɪni dɪˈzæstɚz ɑn ə skwɛr tɪp/
dialogue.zh: 在方形指尖上，缺口就是小災難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tiny chips file out, big ones need a fill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪni tʃɪps faɪl aʊt bɪɡ wʌnz nid ə fɪl/
dialogue.zh: 小挫一挫就沒了，大的要補膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A fill fixes the corner without redoing all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fɪl ˈfɪksɪz ðə ˈkɔrnɚ wɪˈðaʊt ˌriduɪŋ ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 補膠就能修好角，不用整手重做？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, ten minutes and the shape is saved.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ænd ðə ʃeɪp ɪz seɪvd/
dialogue.zh: 對，十分鐘就把形狀救回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saved shapes, please do not cut my skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪvd ʃeɪps pliz du nɑt kʌt maɪ skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 形狀救回來了，拜託不要剪到皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The nipper stays on cuticle, not skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈnɪpɚ steɪz ɑn ˈkjutɪkəl nɑt skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 修甲刀只碰死皮，不碰活皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nipper is the metal tool with curved jaws.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɪpɚ ɪz ðə ˈmɛtəl tul wɪð kɝvd dʒɔz/
dialogue.zh: 修甲刀就是那個彎口金屬工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I sterilize it in the small box.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ ˈstɛrəˌlaɪz ɪt ɪn ðə smɔl bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 對，我會放進小消毒盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That box clicks, it means tools are clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bɑks klɪks ɪt minz tulz ɑr klin/
dialogue.zh: 那個盒子會喀一聲，代表工具乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ultraviolet for twenty minutes between clients.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌltrəˈvaɪələt fɚ ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts bɪˈtwin ˈklaɪənts/
dialogue.zh: 每位客人之間用紫外線照二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes clean, my hands feel safer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts klin maɪ hændz fil ˈseɪfɚ/
dialogue.zh: 消毒廿分鐘，我的手感覺安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safety first, then beauty, that is the order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈseɪfti fɜrst ðɛn ˈbjuti ðæt ɪz ði ˈɔrdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 安全第一，美觀第二，順序就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The order is fine, can you check both hands?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔrdɚ ɪz faɪn kæn ju tʃɛk boʊθ hændz/
dialogue.zh: 順序沒問題，你能檢查我兩手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring them close together, I compare the curves.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðɛm kloʊs təˈɡɛðɚ aɪ kəmˈpɛr ðə kɝvz/
dialogue.zh: 把兩手靠過來，我比對弧度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Together they look uneven on the left side.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈɡɛðɚ ðeɪ lʊk ʌnˈivən ɑn ðə lɛft saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 一比就看出來，左手那邊不整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The left ring nail grew crooked, I see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɛft rɪŋ neɪl ɡru ˈkrʊkɪd aɪ si/
dialogue.zh: 左手無名指那片長歪了，我看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crooked since a door hit it years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrʊkɪd sɪns ə dɔr hɪt ɪt jɪrz əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 幾年前被門撞到，從此就歪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I follow its curve, no forcing it straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈfɑloʊ ɪts kɝv noʊ ˈfɔrsɪŋ ɪt streɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我順著它的弧度修，不硬掰直。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forcing would split the plate, understood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrsɪŋ wʊd splɪt ðə pleɪt ˌʌndɚˈstʊd/
dialogue.zh: 硬掰會讓甲面裂開，我懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, work with the nail, not against it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wɜrk wɪð ðə neɪl nɑt əˈɡɛnst ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，順著指甲做，不要跟它對抗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With the nail, I like that as a rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ðə neɪl aɪ laɪk ðæt æz ə rul/
dialogue.zh: 順著指甲，這規則我喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rule number one here, everything else is color.
dialogue.phonetic: /rul ˈnʌmbɚ wʌn hɪr ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɛls ɪz ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這是店裡第一規則，其他都交給顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Color comes after we soak the skin soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌlɚ kʌmz ˈæftɚ wi soʊk ðə skɪn sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 顏色要等把皮泡軟以後再上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soaking is next, the bowl is filling now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsoʊkɪŋ ɪz nɛkst ðə boʊl ɪz ˈfɪlɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 下一步是泡手，水碗正在裝水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Filling takes warm water and a softening drop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪlɪŋ teɪks wɔrm ˈwɔtɚ ænd ə ˈsɔfənɪŋ drɑp/
dialogue.zh: 要裝溫水再加一滴軟化液。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two drops only, more makes the skin slippery.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu drɑps ˈoʊnli mɔr meɪks ðə skɪn ˈslɪpɚi/
dialogue.zh: 只加兩滴，太多皮膚會打滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slippery is bad, my phone slides off tables.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslɪpɚi ɪz bæd maɪ foʊn slaɪdz ɔf ˈteɪbəlz/
dialogue.zh: 太滑很糟，我手機常從桌上滑落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then grip the towel rail while you lift out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡrɪp ðə ˈtaʊəl reɪl waɪl ju lɪft aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 那把手抽出時就抓著毛巾桿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lifting out slowly, shape done for today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪftɪŋ aʊt ˈsloʊli ʃeɪp dʌn fɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢抽出來，今天的形狀修完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shape done, both hands match, look at that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪp dʌn boʊθ hændz mætʃ lʊk æt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 形狀完成，兩手一致，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bowl looks deep, can my whole hand fit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə boʊl lʊks dip kæn maɪ hoʊl hænd fɪt/
dialogue.zh: 水碗看起來好深，我整手放得下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up to the knuckles, that softens every cuticle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp tə ðə ˈnʌkəlz ðæt ˈsɔfənz ˈɛvri ˈkjutɪkəl/
dialogue.zh: 泡到指節就好，那樣每片死皮都會軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water temperature good, not too hot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtɚ tɛmˈpɛrətʃɚ ɡʊd nɑt tu hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 水溫剛好，不會太燙吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm, never hot, hot water weakens the plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈnɛvər hɑt hɑt ˈwɔtɚ ˈwikənz ðə pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只溫不燙，太熱會讓甲面變弱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weakening the plate, I did not know that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwikənɪŋ ðə pleɪt aɪ dɪd nɑt noʊ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 會讓甲面變弱，這我都不知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot water lifts polish sooner, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt ˈwɔtɚ lɪfts ˈpɑlɪʃ ˈsunɪk trʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 太熱的水會讓指甲油早點翹，信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten fingers in, the first minute feels nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈfɪŋɡɚz ɪn ðə fɜrst ˈmɪnɪt filz naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 十根手指都泡進去，第一分鐘很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy it, the next part is all pushing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ɪt ðə nɛkst pɑrt ɪz ɔl ˈpʊʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好好享受，下一步就全是推皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pushing is fine, I like the soaking best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʊʃɪŋ ɪz faɪn aɪ laɪk ðə ˈsoʊkɪŋ bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 推皮沒問題，我最喜歡泡手這一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soaking helps, dry skin rips under pushing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsoʊkɪŋ hɛlps draɪ skɪn rɪps ˈʌndɚ ˈpʊʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 泡過有幫助，乾皮膚一推就會破。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long before the dead skin lifts?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ bɪˈfɔr ðə dɛd skɪn lɪfts/
dialogue.zh: 死皮要泡多久才會浮起來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around four minutes, then I push it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd fɔr ˈmɪnɪts ðɛn aɪ pʊʃ ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 大約四分鐘，然後我用推棒推回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pushing sounds gentler than cutting it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʊʃɪŋ saʊndz ˈdʒɛntəlɚ ðæn ˈkʌtɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 推聽起來比剪溫和多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cutting bleeds, pushing just flattens the ridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌtɪŋ blidz ˈpʊʃɪŋ dʒʌst ˈflætənz ðə rɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 剪會流血，推只是把掀起的那條壓平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No bleeding please, I flinch at the nipper.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈblidɪŋ pliz aɪ flɪntʃ æt ðə ˈnɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 拜託不要見血，我看到修甲刀就縮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will warn you before each nip, deal?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl wɔrn ju bɪˈfɔr itʃ nɪp dil/
dialogue.zh: 每剪一下之前我會先提醒你，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, also my hangnail is on the middle finger.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil ˈɔlsoʊ maɪ ˈhæŋneɪl ɪz ɑn ðə ˈmɪdəl ˈfɪŋɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，還有我中指有一根倒刺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see it, soaking makes it easy to trim.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɪt ˈsoʊkɪŋ meɪks ɪt ˈizi tə trɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我看到了，泡軟以後好修剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trim only the loose part, keep the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /trɪm ˈoʊnli ðə lus pɑrt kip ðə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 只剪翹起來那段，其他留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, nippers are for loose skin only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd ˈnɪpɚz ɑr fɚ lus skɪn ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 我知道，修甲刀只對付鬆起的皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water is cooling already, is that okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔtɚ ɪz ˈkulɪŋ ɔlˈrɛdi ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 水已經涼了，這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, cool water still softens the cuticle.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn kul ˈwɔtɚ stɪl ˈsɔfənz ðə ˈkjutɪkəl/
dialogue.zh: 可以，涼水還是能軟化甲皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I hate when someone pours fresh hot water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ heɪt wɛn ˈsʌmˌwʌn pɔrz frɛʃ hɑt ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我最怕別人突然倒滾水進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only refill if the bowl drops below warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊnli rɪˈfɪl ɪf ðə boʊl drɑps bɪˈloʊ wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 我只有水涼透才會再添溫水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Below warm means the polish does not spread.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈloʊ wɔrm minz ðə ˈpɑlɪʃ dʊz nɑt sprɛd/
dialogue.zh: 水太涼的話指甲油就抹不開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, cold nails make the polish bead up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli koʊld neɪlz meɪk ðə ˈpɑlɪʃ bid ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，冰指甲會讓油聚成小珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bead up, that means little drops on the nail?
dialogue.phonetic: /bid ʌp ðæt minz ˈlɪtəl drɑps ɑn ðə neɪl/
dialogue.zh: 聚成珠就是在甲面上變成小滴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ugly drops that chip off in one day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈʌɡli drɑps ðæt tʃɪp ɔf ɪn wʌn deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，難看的小滴，一天就掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chipping in one day, I have done that before.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɪpɪŋ ɪn wʌn deɪ aɪ hæv dʌn ðæt bɪˈfɔr/
dialogue.zh: 一天就掉，我以前常這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not today, the soak fixed that problem already.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt təˈdeɪ ðə soʊk fɪkst ðæt ˈprɑbləm ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 今天不會，泡手已經解掉那個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time is up, my fingertips look pruny now.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm ɪz ʌp maɪ ˈfɪŋɡɚˌtɪps lʊk ˈpruni naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 時間到，我的指尖都泡皺了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slightly soft, out you go, dry on the towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslaɪtli sɔft aʊt ju ɡoʊ draɪ ɑn ðə ˈtaʊəl/
dialogue.zh: 剛好變軟，手出來吧，用毛巾擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drying every finger gap, polish hates moisture.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdraɪɪŋ ˈɛvri ˈfɪŋɡɚ ɡæp ˈpɑlɪʃ heɪts ˈmɔɪstʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 指縫都要擦乾，指甲油最怕濕氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very true, damp nails peel the base coat off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri tru dæmp neɪlz pil ðə beɪs koʊt ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 真的，濕指甲會把底膠整片推掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peeling base coat, that is my history.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpilɪŋ beɪs koʊt ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈhɪstəri/
dialogue.zh: 底膠剝落這毛病我有歷史了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today we wipe the plate with a dehydrator.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ wi waɪp ðə pleɪt wɪð ə diˌhaɪˈretɚ/
dialogue.zh: 今天我們先用脫水棉擦甲面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dehydrator smells sharp, like alcohol.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə diˌhaɪˈretɚ smɛlz ʃɑrp laɪk ˈæləˌkɔl/
dialogue.zh: 那個脫水液味道很刺，像酒精。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It evaporates in seconds, no smell left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪˈvæpəˌreɪts ɪn ˈsɛkəndz noʊ smɛl lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 幾秒就揮發，不會殘留味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No smell left is good for my closed office.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ smɛl lɛft ɪz ɡʊd fɚ maɪ kloʊzd ˈɔfɪs/
dialogue.zh: 不留味道對我密閉的辦公室很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then choose unscented oil for after care.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃuz ʌnˈsɛntɪd ɔɪl fɚ ˈæftɚ kɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那就選無香的護指油回家保養。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unscented oil, where do I buy that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈsɛntɪd ɔɪl wɛr du aɪ baɪ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 無香的指緣油，我在哪裡買？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our counter, eight dollars, it lasts months.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr ˈkaʊntɚ eɪt ˈdɑlərz ɪt læsts mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 我們櫃台有，八美元，能用好幾個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Months from one bottle, that is worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌnθs frʌm wʌn ˈbɑtəl ðæt ɪz wɜrθ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一瓶能用幾個月，那很划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one drop per cuticle each night works.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn drɑp pɚ ˈkjutɪkəl itʃ naɪt wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 對，每片甲皮晚上一滴就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each night, that is a small habit to keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ naɪt ðæt ɪz ə smɔl ˈhæbɪt tə kip/
dialogue.zh: 每晚都擦，這是個能養的小習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small habits keep the gel edges from lifting.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈhæbɪts kip ðə dʒɛl ˈɛdʒɪz frʌm ˈlɪftɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 小習慣能讓凝膠邊緣不翹起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lifting edges, I always check them first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪftɪŋ ˈɛdʒɪz aɪ ˈɔlweɪz tʃɛk ðɛm fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 翹邊我最會檢查，每次都先看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check gently, pulling a lifted edge rips gel.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ˈdʒɛntli ˈpʊlɪŋ ə ˈlɪftɪd ɛdʒ rɪps dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕看就好，一拉翹邊會整片撕掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ripping gel hurts, last time it took a layer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪpɪŋ dʒɛl hɜrts læst taɪm ɪt tʊk ə ˈleɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 撕凝膠會痛，上次還撕掉一層甲面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That layer grows back, but slowly, in months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈleɪɚ ɡroʊz bæk bʌt ˈsloʊli ɪn mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 那層會長回來，但很慢，要好幾個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In months, so I stop picking right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn mʌnθs soʊ aɪ stɑp ˈpɪkɪŋ raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 要幾個月，所以我現在就戒掉摳的習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best decision today, I will hold you to it.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst dɪˈsɪʒən təˈdeɪ aɪ wɪl hoʊld ju tə ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今天是最好的決定，我會盯著你做到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold me to it, note it on my card.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld mi tə ɪt noʊt ɪt ɑn maɪ kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 盯著我，幫我在卡上註明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I write it in your client notes tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ raɪt ɪt ɪn jʊr ˈklaɪənt noʊts təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚會記到你的備註裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight, good, my nails are dust free now?
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt ɡʊd maɪ neɪlz ɑr dʌst fri naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我指甲上的粉塵清乾淨了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, one brush with this soft bristle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst wʌn brʌʃ wɪð ðɪs sɔft ˈbrɪsəl/
dialogue.zh: 快好了，用這支軟毛刷再刷一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brushing dust off, that tickles my wrist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbrʌʃɪŋ dʌst ɔf ðæt ˈtɪkəlz maɪ rɪst/
dialogue.zh: 把粉塵刷掉時，我手腕會癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I brush toward the tip, not the skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri aɪ brʌʃ təˈwɔrd ðə tɪp nɑt ðə skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我朝指尖方向刷，不刷皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toward the tip, smart, dust ruins a wet coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈwɔrd ðə tɪp smɑrt dʌst ruˈɪnz ə wɛt koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 往指尖刷，聰明，粉塵會毀了濕的那層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ruins it completely, that is why we wipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ruˈɪnz ɪt kəmˈplitli ðæt ɪz waɪ wi waɪp/
dialogue.zh: 會整個毀掉，所以我們才要擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wiping now with the primer pad, cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwaɪpɪŋ naʊ wɪð ðə ˈpraɪmɚ pæd koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 現在用底膏棉片擦，涼涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Primer is sticky, so the gel grips tightly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpraɪmɚ ɪz ˈstɪki soʊ ðə dʒɛl ɡrɪps ˈtaɪtli/
dialogue.zh: 底膏黏黏的，凝膠才會抓緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gripping tightly means my next set lasts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡrɪpɪŋ ˈtaɪtli minz maɪ nɛkst sɛt læsts/
dialogue.zh: 抓得緊代表我這一組會撐久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, how well it sticks is the secret.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli haʊ wɛl ɪt stɪks ɪz ðə ˈsɪkrɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，能黏多好就是祕訣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sticking well, that is what I paid for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɪkɪŋ wɛl ðæt ɪz wʌt aɪ peɪd fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 黏得牢，就是我花錢要買的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then here comes the base coat, very thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hɪr kʌmz ðə beɪs koʊt ˈvɛri θɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那底膠要上場了，薄薄一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thin base coat, why not just one thick layer?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn beɪs koʊt waɪ nɑt dʒʌst wʌn θɪk ˈleɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 底膠要薄，為什麼不能一次塗厚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thick layers trap air and wrinkle under light.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪk ˈleɪɚz træp ɛr ænd ˈwɪŋkəl ˈʌndɚ laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 厚層會包空氣，一烤就起皺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrinkles under the lamp, I saw that once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪŋkəlz ˈʌndɚ ðə læmp aɪ sɔ ðæt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 烤燈下起皺，我曾經看過一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugly, and no filing fixes a wrinkled coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌɡli ænd noʊ ˈfaɪlɪŋ ˈfɪksɪz ə ˈwɪŋkəld koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 很醜，而且挫磨救不回皺掉的層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So redo it, peel off and start again?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ rɪˈdu ɪt pil ɔf ænd stɑrt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 所以要重做，撕掉再來一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the gel, never your nail, that is it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə dʒɛl ˈnɛvər jʊr neɪl ðæt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只重做凝膠，不碰你的指甲，重點就在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The point is my nail stays healthy underneath.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɔɪnt ɪz maɪ neɪl steɪz ˈhɛlθi ˌʌndərˈniθ/
dialogue.zh: 重點是我的指甲在裡面保持健康。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Healthy nails hold gloss, damaged ones let go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛlθi neɪlz hoʊld ɡlɑs ˈdæmɪdʒd wʌnz lɛt ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 健康指甲抓得住光亮，受損的就鬆手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Letting go, that is my nail's hobby, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛtɪŋ ɡoʊ ðæt ɪz maɪ neɪlz ˈhɑbi ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 鬆手這毛病，很遺憾是我的指甲的愛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We break the habit today with a good base.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi breɪk ðə ˈhæbɪt təˈdeɪ wɪð ə ɡʊd beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 今天我們用好的底膠把這個習慣打破。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A good base plus my patience, that is it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡʊd beɪs plʌs maɪ ˈpeɪʃəns ðæt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好的底膠加上我的耐心，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Patience helps, this base coat needs one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪʃəns hɛlps ðɪs beɪs koʊt nidz wʌn ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 耐心有幫助，這層底膠要烤一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One minute under the lamp, then the color?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈmɪnɪt ˈʌndɚ ðə læmp ðɛn ðə ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 燈下一分鐘，然後上顏色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then color, two thin coats, we start with brick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈkʌlɚ tu θɪn koʊts wi stɑrt wɪð brɪk/
dialogue.zh: 接著上色，薄塗兩層，先用磚紅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brick red first on which finger, any rule?
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪk rɛd fɜrst ɑn wɪtʃ ˈfɪŋɡɚ ˈɛni rul/
dialogue.zh: 磚紅先從哪根手指開始，有規則嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I start at the pinky and work inward.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ stɑrt æt ðə ˈpɪŋki ænd wɜrk ɪnˈwɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 我從小指開始，往內一片一片塗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: From the pinky inward, so the thumb is last.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə ˈpɪŋki ɪnˈwɔrd soʊ ðə θʌm ɪz læst/
dialogue.zh: 從小指往內，所以拇指最後塗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, thumbs move most, so they dry last.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt θʌmz muv moʊst soʊ ðeɪ draɪ læst/
dialogue.zh: 對，拇指最會動，所以要最後乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drying last is clever, I had not thought that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdraɪɪŋ læst ɪz ˈklɛvɚ aɪ hæd nɑt θɔt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 最後乾這想法很聰明，我沒想到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Experience teaches the order of painting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈspɪriəns ˈtitʃɪz ði ˈɔrdɚ ʌv ˈpeɪntɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 經驗會教你上色的順序。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The order matters, my hands shake a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔrdɚ ˈmætɚz maɪ hændz ʃeɪk ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 順序很重要，我的手會稍微抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe out slowly, shaky hands smear edges.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið aʊt ˈsloʊli ˈʃeɪki hændz smɪr ˈɛdʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢吐氣，抖的手會把邊界弄糊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smearing edges, I will breathe twice, deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsmɪrɪŋ ˈɛdʒɪz aɪ wɪl brið twaɪs dil/
dialogue.zh: 會弄糊邊緣，那我呼吸兩次，可以吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, brush ready, hold your pinky out now.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil brʌʃ ˈrɛdi hoʊld jʊr ˈpɪŋki aʊt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，筆刷準備好，先把小指伸出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out it goes, tell me if it looks thick.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt ɪt ɡoʊz tɛl mi ɪf ɪt lʊks θɪk/
dialogue.zh: 伸出來了，如果太厚要跟我說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One thin stroke, I am filling from the center.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪn stroʊk aɪ æm ˈfɪlɪŋ frʌm ðə ˈsɛntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 薄薄一趟，我從中間往外填。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: From the center outward, no streak lines today.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə ˈsɛntɚ ˈaʊtwərd noʊ strik laɪnz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 從中間往外，今天不要有條紋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Streaks come from rushing, we are unhurried.
dialogue.phonetic: /striks kʌm frʌm ˈrʌʃɪŋ wi ɑr ʌnˈhɝid/
dialogue.zh: 條紋是趕出來的，我們不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unhurried is nice, nobody rushed me all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈhɝid ɪz naɪs ˈnoʊbədi rʌʃt mi ɔl wik/
dialogue.zh: 不急真舒服，我整週都被趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salon rule, each nail gets its own three strokes.
dialogue.phonetic: /səˈlɑn rul itʃ neɪl ɡɛts ɪts oʊn θri stroʊks/
dialogue.zh: 店裡的規矩，每片指甲有自己的三筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three strokes per nail, that is real craft.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri stroʊks pɚ neɪl ðæt ɪz ril kræft/
dialogue.zh: 每片三筆，這才是真功夫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Craft plus your patience, now hold still please.
dialogue.phonetic: /kræft plʌs jʊr ˈpeɪʃəns naʊ hoʊld stɪl pliz/
dialogue.zh: 功夫加你的耐心，現在請別動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still as stone, the base coat is drying hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl æz stoʊn ðə beɪs koʊt ɪz ˈdraɪɪŋ hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 動如石頭，底膠已經硬了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, next comes the first layer of brick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd nɛkst kʌmz ðə fɜrst ˈleɪɚ ʌv brɪk/
dialogue.zh: 好，接著上磚紅的第一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That first coat looks see through already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt fɜrst koʊt lʊks si θru ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 第一層看起來已經透光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See through is normal, the second coat covers it.
dialogue.phonetic: /si θru ɪz ˈnɔrməl ðə ˈsɛkənd koʊt ˈkʌvərz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 透光很正常，第二層就會蓋滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the pale patches will disappear on layer two?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə peɪl ˈpætʃɪz wɪl ˌdɪsəˈpɪr ɑn ˈleɪɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 那淡掉的塊會在第二層不見嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, brick is a two coat color, not three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli brɪk ɪz ə tu koʊt ˈkʌlɚ nɑt θri/
dialogue.zh: 大部分會，磚紅是兩層色，不用三層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So wait for this one coat to cure first?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ weɪt fɔr ðɪs wʌn koʊt tə kjʊr fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 那我先等這一層烤乾，再說？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cure it now, sixty seconds, then coat two.
dialogue.phonetic: /kjʊr ɪt naʊ ˈsɪksti ˈsɛkəndz ðɛn koʊt tu/
dialogue.zh: 現在就烤六十秒，再上第二層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the lamp again, my nails like the warmth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə læmp əˈɡɛn maɪ neɪlz laɪk ðə wɔrmθ/
dialogue.zh: 又到燈底下，我的指甲喜歡那個溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, some gel gets hot, tell me fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl sʌm dʒɛl ɡɛts hɑt tɛl mi fæst/
dialogue.zh: 小心，有些凝膠會發燙，要馬上說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If it stings I say so, no polite talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ɪt stɪŋz aɪ seɪ soʊ noʊ pəˈlaɪt tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 刺痛我就會說，這事不客氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, sting means heat spike, pull your hand out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd stɪŋ minz hit spaɪk pʊl jʊr hænd aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 好，刺痛就是熱衝，把手從燈裡抽出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pulling out early, do I lose the coat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʊlɪŋ aʊt ˈɜrli du aɪ luz ðə koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 太早抽出來，這層會白塗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, slide it back in, the gel forgives that.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ slaɪd ɪt bæk ɪn ðə dʒɛl fɚˈɡivz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 不會，滑回去就好，凝膠很包容。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forgiving gel, good news for my impatient hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚˈɡivɪŋ dʒɛl ɡʊd nuz fɚ maɪ ɪmˈpeɪʃənt hændz/
dialogue.zh: 會包容的凝膠，對我急手的人是好消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Impatient hands need short coats, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪmˈpeɪʃənt hændz nid ʃɔrt koʊts ðæt ɪz ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 急手的人要塗短層，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thin coats, meaning less polish on the brush?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn koʊts ˈminɪŋ lɛs ˈpɑlɪʃ ɑn ðə brʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 薄層就是筆刷上少沾一點油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, wipe half the brush on the bottle neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli waɪp hæf ðə brʌʃ ɑn ðə ˈbɑtəl nɛk/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，在瓶口刮掉一半的油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wiping the brush, that stops the flooding too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwaɪpɪŋ ðə brʌʃ ðæt stɑps ðə ˈflʌdɪŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 刮掉多餘的油，也能防止流得滿桌？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, flooding runs onto your cuticle skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈflʌdɪŋ rʌnz ˈɑntu jʊr ˈkjutɪkəl skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，油太多會流到你的甲皮上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cuticle flood looks awful in close photos.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkjutɪkəl flʌd lʊks ˈɔfəl ɪn kloʊs ˈfoʊtoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 甲皮一片油，拍特寫會很難看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I clean it with an orange stick, right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ klin ɪt wɪð ən ˈɔrɪndʒ stɪk raɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我會馬上用橘木棒清乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An orange stick, the wooden one with a point?
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈɔrɪndʒ stɪk ðə ˈwʊdən wʌn wɪð ə pɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 橘木棒，就是那個尖頭木棍？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it lifts wet gel off the skin cleanly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt lɪfts wɛt dʒɛl ɔf ðə skɪn ˈklinli/
dialogue.zh: 對，它能乾淨地把濕凝膠推離皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cleanly now, later it peels like a band.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklinli naʊ ˈleɪtɚ ɪt pilz laɪk ə bænd/
dialogue.zh: 現在清掉，不然之後會像一圈帶子剝落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, one strip of dried gel around the nail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wʌn strɪp ʌv draɪd dʒɛl əˈraʊnd ðə neɪl/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，就是一圈乾掉的凝膠皮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That lifted strip, I hate when it peels up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈlɪftɪd strɪp aɪ heɪt wɛn ɪt pilz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 那圈翹起來的皮，我最恨它剝開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we keep the edge clean, no strip forms.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi kip ði ɛdʒ klin noʊ strɪp fɔrmz/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們保持邊緣乾淨，就不會形成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No strip forms, that is the second coat now?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ strɪp fɔrmz ðæt ɪz ðə ˈsɛkənd koʊt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不會形成那一圈，現在就是第二層了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it comes, watch how the color deepens.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt kʌmz wɑtʃ haʊ ðə ˈkʌlɚ ˈdipənz/
dialogue.zh: 第二層要來了，看顏色怎麼變深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It deepens fast, from pale brick to real brick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈdipənz fæst frʌm peɪl brɪk tə ril brɪk/
dialogue.zh: 變深好快，從淡磚紅變成真的磚紅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second coat does that, the first is always weak.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd koʊt dʊz ðæt ðə fɜrst ɪz ˈɔlweɪz wik/
dialogue.zh: 第二層就是這個效果，第一層總是比較淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Single coat sets look cheap, that is the truth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪŋɡəl koʊt sɛts lʊk tʃip ðæt ɪz ðə truθ/
dialogue.zh: 只塗一層看起來很廉價，這是實話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Truth, and they show white spots at the tips.
dialogue.phonetic: /truθ ænd ðeɪ ʃoʊ waɪt spɑts æt ðə tɪps/
dialogue.zh: 對，而且指尖會露出白點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: White spots at tips mean thin coverage, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪt spɑts æt tɪps min θɪn ˈkʌvərɪdʒ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 指尖有白點就是蓋得不夠，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a third coat fixes those two nails.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə θɜrd koʊt ˈfɪksɪz ðoz tu neɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 對，第三層就能救那兩片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two nails only, the pinky and the index?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu neɪlz ˈoʊnli ðə ˈpɪŋki ænd ði ˈɪndɛks/
dialogue.zh: 只有兩片，小指和食指？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pinky and middle, they take the most knocks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɪŋki ænd ˈmɪdəl ðeɪ teɪk ðə moʊst nɑks/
dialogue.zh: 是小指和中指，它們被撞最多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Most knocks, so extra coat there is smart.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst nɑks soʊ ˈɛkstrə koʊt ðɛr ɪz smɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 被撞最多，所以那裡多上一層聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart and cheap, one drop of gel, no charge.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ænd tʃip wʌn drɑp ʌv dʒɛl noʊ tʃɑrdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明又便宜，一滴凝膠，不加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No charge, I like that honesty in the bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tʃɑrdʒ aɪ laɪk ðæt ˈɑnəsti ɪn ðə bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 不加錢，我喜歡帳單上這種誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honesty keeps hands coming back, simple math.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəsti kips hændz ˈkʌmɪŋ bæk ˈsɪmpəl mæθ/
dialogue.zh: 誠實讓手願意回來，算術很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back in three weeks, then we do this again?
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɪn θri wikz ðɛn wi du ðɪs əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 三週後回來，然後再來一次這套？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a fill, less work, same brick red family.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə fɪl lɛs wɜrk seɪm brɪk rɛd ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 到時補膠就好，工少一點，同一色系。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same family saves me from choosing again.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈfæməli seɪvz mi frʌm ˈtʃuzɪŋ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 同一色系讓我不用再費心挑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Choose later, right now the lamp needs you.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃuz ˈleɪtɚ raɪt naʊ ðə læmp nidz ju/
dialogue.zh: 之後再挑，現在燈需要你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Into the lamp, fingers spread like before?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪntu ðə læmp ˈfɪŋɡɚz sprɛd laɪk bɪˈfɔr/
dialogue.zh: 伸進燈裡，手指像剛才那樣張開？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tips up, so the gel does not pool there.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪps ʌp soʊ ðə dʒɛl dʊz nɑt pul ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 指尖朝上，凝膠才不會在尖端堆積。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pooling at the tip would look like a bump.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpulɪŋ æt ðə tɪp wʊd lʊk laɪk ə bʌmp/
dialogue.zh: 尖端堆起來會像一個小鼓包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bump chips first, so I check edges twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bʌmp tʃɪps fɜrst soʊ aɪ tʃɛk ˈɛdʒɪz twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 鼓包會先掉，所以每個邊我都看兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check twice, then the top coat seals everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk twaɪs ðɛn ðə tɑp koʊt silz ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 看兩次，接著封層把所有東西封住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seals it, one glossy layer, ninety seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /silz ɪt wʌn ˈɡlɑsi ˈleɪɚ ˈnaɪnti ˈsɛkəndz/
dialogue.zh: 封住它，亮面一層，烤九十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety seconds feels long, can I read?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti ˈsɛkəndz filz lɔŋ kæn aɪ rid/
dialogue.zh: 九十秒感覺好長，我能看書嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read anything, just keep your wrist on the pad.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ˈɛniθɪŋ dʒʌst kip jʊr rɪst ɑn ðə pæd/
dialogue.zh: 看什麼都行，手腕壓在墊上就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the pad, good, my arm gets tired fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə pæd ɡʊd maɪ ɑrm ɡɛts ˈtaɪərd fæst/
dialogue.zh: 壓在墊上，好，我的手臂很容易累。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tired arms shake, so I rest your elbow higher.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪərd ɑrmz ʃeɪk soʊ aɪ rɛst jʊr ˈɛlboʊ ˈhaɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 手累了會抖，所以我把墊手移高一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Higher is perfect, thank you for noticing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhaɪɚ ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt θæŋk ju fɚ ˈnoʊtɪsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 高一點剛正好，謝謝你注意到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
