dialogue.text: Noticing is my job, the gel is your part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪsɪŋ ɪz maɪ dʒɑb ðə dʒɛl ɪz jʊr pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 觀察是我的工作，凝膠那邊是你的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My part is staying still, I can do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ pɑrt ɪz ˈsteɪɪŋ stɪl aɪ kæn du ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 我的部分就是別動，這我做得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then hold, the top coat goes on in sections.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hoʊld ðə tɑp koʊt ɡoʊz ɑn ɪn ˈsɛkʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 那就撐住，封層是一區一區上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In sections, so no brush lines cross over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ˈsɛkʃənz soʊ noʊ brʌʃ laɪnz krɔs ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 分區上，所以不會有交叉的刷痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, brush marks show under light forever.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt brʌʃ mɑrks ʃoʊ ˈʌndɚ laɪt fɚˈɛvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 對，刷痕在光下會永遠現形。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forever under light, that is scary for photos.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚˈɛvɚ ˈʌndɚ laɪt ðæt ɪz ˈskɛri fɚ ˈfoʊtoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 永遠在光下現形，拍照會很可怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photos forgive brush marks, chips they never do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz fɚˈɡiv brʌʃ mɑrks tʃɪps ðeɪ ˈnɛvər du/
dialogue.zh: 照片原諒刷痕，但絕不原諒缺口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chips never forgiven, so the edges matter most.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪps ˈnɛvər fɚˈɡivən soʊ ði ˈɛdʒɪz ˈmætɚ moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 缺口不被原諒，所以邊角最重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The edges matter, I seal under the free tip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛdʒɪz ˈmætɚ aɪ sil ˈʌndɚ ðə fri tɪp/
dialogue.zh: 邊角很重要，我會封到白邊下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sealing under the tip buys me another week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsilɪŋ ˈʌndɚ ðə tɪp baɪz mi əˈnʌðɚ wik/
dialogue.zh: 封到指尖下面，就能多換一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes ten days, depends how you use hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz tɛn deɪz dɪˈpɛndz haʊ ju juz hændz/
dialogue.zh: 有時是十天，要看你手怎麼用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wash dishes by hand, does that hurt gel?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑʃ ˈdɪʃɪz baɪ hænd dʊz ðæt hɜrt dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 我用手洗碗，那樣會傷凝膠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hurts, so wear gloves when you wash dishes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hɜrts soʊ wɛr ɡlʌvz wɛn ju wɑʃ ˈdɪʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 會傷，所以洗碗時要戴手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gloves hidden in my drawer, I will start today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlʌvz ˈhɪdən ɪn maɪ drɔr aɪ wɪl stɑrt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 手套就在我抽屜裡，我今天開始戴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today is the day, the gel thanks your gloves.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ɪz ðə deɪ ðə dʒɛl θæŋks jʊr ɡlʌvz/
dialogue.zh: 就是今天，凝膠會感謝你的手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gel thanks them, that made me smile again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɛl θæŋks ðɛm ðæt meɪd mi smaɪl əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 凝膠會感謝它們，這句話又讓我笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smiling is fine now, the top coat is cured.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsmaɪlɪŋ ɪz faɪn naʊ ðə tɑp koʊt ɪz kjʊrd/
dialogue.zh: 現在笑沒關係，封層已經烤好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cured already, it looks like glass on nails.
dialogue.phonetic: /kjʊrd ɔlˈrɛdi ɪt lʊks laɪk ɡlæs ɑn neɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 就烤好了，指甲上像蓋了一層玻璃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That shine is two coats plus the seal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ʃaɪn ɪz tu koʊts plʌs ðə sil/
dialogue.zh: 那個亮是兩層色加一道封膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shine is nice, does it stay shiny long?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃaɪn ɪz naɪs dʊz ɪt steɪ ˈʃaɪni lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 亮得很漂亮，能撐多久不暗沉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About two weeks, then it dulls near the tips.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt tu wikz ðɛn ɪt dʌlz nɪr ðə tɪps/
dialogue.zh: 大約兩週，接著指尖那邊會變暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dulling tips, I can live with that honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʌlɪŋ tɪps aɪ kæn lɪv wɪð ðæt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 指尖變暗，這點我真的能接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people just buff the dull tips lightly.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl dʒʌst bʌf ðə dʌl tɪps ˈlaɪtli/
dialogue.zh: 多數人只是輕輕拋一下指尖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buffing dull tips, that I can do at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌfɪŋ dʌl tɪps ðæt aɪ kæn du æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 輕拋暗掉的指尖，這個我在家能做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do it gently, three strokes, then oil again.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ɪt ˈdʒɛntli θri stroʊks ðɛn ɔɪl əˈɡɪn/
dialogue.zh: 要輕，三下就好，然後再上油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oil after buffing, the little bottle on the shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɪl ˈæftɚ ˈbʌfɪŋ ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈbɑtəl ɑn ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 拋完要上油，架上那小瓶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one, it sits with the gel removers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪt sɪts wɪð ðə dʒɛl rɪˈmulvɚz/
dialogue.zh: 就是那瓶，旁邊擺著卸膠水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Removers next to it, I will need one soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmulvɚz nɛkst tə ɪt aɪ wɪl nid wʌn sun/
dialogue.zh: 卸膠水就在旁邊，我很快會需要一瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not buy, a soak here keeps nails safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt baɪ ə soʊk hɪr kips neɪlz seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 先別買，在店裡卸才能保住指甲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soaking off here, so I come back for removal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsoʊkɪŋ ɔf hɪr soʊ aɪ kʌm bæk fɚ rɪˈmul/
dialogue.zh: 回店裡卸，所以我回來做卸膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fifteen minutes and your nails are bare.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɪfˈtin ˈmɪnɪts ænd jʊr neɪlz ɑr bɛr/
dialogue.zh: 對，十五分鐘你的指甲就空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bare nails again, then a rest week between sets?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛr neɪlz əˈɡɛn ðɛn ə rɛst wik bɪˈtwin sɛts/
dialogue.zh: 指甲重新空著，兩組之間休息一週？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest weeks help, the plate breathes and hardens.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst wikz hɛlp ðə pleɪt briðz ænd ˈhɑrdənz/
dialogue.zh: 休息一週有幫助，甲面會變硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hardening takes time, my nails stay soft for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑrdənɪŋ teɪks taɪm maɪ neɪlz steɪ sɔft fɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 變硬需要時間，我的指甲現在還偏軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft plates need care, no opening cans today.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft pleɪts nid kɛr noʊ ˈoʊpənɪŋ kænz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 軟甲面要小心，今天別用指甲開罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thin sides, so avoid filing there, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn saɪdz soʊ əˈvɔɪd ˈfaɪlɪŋ ðɛr raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我兩側很薄，所以那邊不要挫，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, I buffer only the top of the plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli aɪ ˈbʌfɚ ˈoʊnli ðə tɑp ʌv ðə pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，我只拋甲面最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just the top, that keeps my nails strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə tɑp ðæt kips maɪ neɪlz strɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 只拋上面，這樣指甲才留得住強度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong nails hold the second coat for weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɔŋ neɪlz hoʊld ðə ˈsɛkənd koʊt fɚ wikz/
dialogue.zh: 強健的指甲能把第二層撐好幾週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weeks of second coat color, I am happy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wikz ʌv ˈsɛkənd koʊt ˈkʌlɚ aɪ æm ˈhæpi/
dialogue.zh: 第二層的顏色能撐好幾週，我很滿意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy hands, look, both sides match perfectly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi hændz lʊk boʊθ saɪdz mætʃ ˈpɜrfɪktli/
dialogue.zh: 開心的手，你看，兩邊完全對色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfectly matched, the glitter accent still sparkles?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪktli mætʃt ðə ˈɡlɪtɚ ˈæksɛnt stɪl ˈspɑrkəlz/
dialogue.zh: 對得完美，那跳色亮片還閃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Silver dots survived the top coat, see them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪlvɚ dɑts sɚˈvaɪvd ðə tɑp koʊt si ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 銀點撐過封層了，你看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seeing them, worth every second under the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsinɪŋ ðɛm wɜrθ ˈɛvri ˈsɛkənd ˈʌndɚ ðə læmp/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，燈下每一秒都值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lamp earns its keep, now dry and check.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp ɝnz ɪts kip naʊ draɪ ænd tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 那盞燈沒白開，現在擦乾檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Straight question, how many days will this hold?
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪt ˈkwɛstʃən haʊ ˈmɛni deɪz wɪl ðɪs hoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 我直接問，這組能撐幾天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty one days, if your hands behave.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti wʌn deɪz ɪf jʊr hændz bɪˈhev/
dialogue.zh: 二十一天，如果你的手乖一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine never behave, last set died in five days.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ˈnɛvər bɪˈhev læst sɛt daɪd ɪn faɪv deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我的手從來不乖，上次五天就全掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Died in five means something was skipped.
dialogue.phonetic: /daɪd ɪn faɪv minz ˈsʌmθɪŋ wʌz skɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 五天就掉，代表有步驟被跳掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Skipped, the base coat, maybe I washed it off?
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪpt ðə beɪs koʊt ˈmeɪbi aɪ wɑʃt ɪt ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 跳掉底膠？還是被我洗掉了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Washing days later does that, soap cuts gel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑʃɪŋ deɪz ˈleɪtɚ dʊz ðæt soʊp kʌts dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 之後幾天猛洗也會，皂鹼會切凝膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soap cuts gel, I wash my hands twenty times.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊp kʌts dʒɛl aɪ wɑʃ maɪ hændz ˈtwɛnti taɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 皂鹼會切凝膠，我一天洗二十次手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty washes need gloves, or short nails.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti wɑʃɪz nid ɡlʌvz ɔr ʃɔrt neɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 洗這麼多次要戴手套，或是留短甲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Short nails are staying, then tell me the risks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɔrt neɪlz ɑr ˈsteɪɪŋ ðɛn tɛl mi ðə rɪsks/
dialogue.zh: 短指甲我會留著，那請告訴我風險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Biggest risk is long hot dish water, day one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪɡɪst rɪsk ɪz lɔŋ hɑt dɪʃ ˈwɔtɚ deɪ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 最大風險是第一天泡很久的洗碗水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Day one, I can rest my hands, no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /deɪ wʌn aɪ kæn rɛst maɪ hændz noʊ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 第一天我可以讓手休息，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Resting helps the gel finish hardening inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛstɪŋ hɛlps ðə dʒɛl ˈfɪnɪʃ ˈhɑrdənɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 讓手休息，凝膠裡面才會完全硬化。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hardening inside, so the lamp is not the end?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑrdənɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd soʊ ðə læmp ɪz nɑt ði ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 裡面還在硬化，所以烤完不是結束？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lamp sets it, twenty minutes later it seals.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp sɛts ɪt ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ˈleɪtɚ ɪt silz/
dialogue.zh: 燈把它固定，二十分鐘後才封死。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, I will sit here and scroll phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts aɪ wɪl sɪt hɪr ænd skroʊl foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，我就坐這裡滑手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scroll slowly, keep your nails off the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /skroʊl ˈsloʊli kip jʊr neɪlz ɔf ðə skrin/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢滑，指甲別敲到螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My clicks on glass used to chip the color.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ klɪks ɑn ɡlæs jʊst tə tʃɪp ðə ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我用指甲敲玻璃，以前都會把顏色磕掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phone glass is a killer, try a stylus pen.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊn ɡlæs ɪz ə ˈkɪlɚ traɪ ə ˈstaɪləs pɛn/
dialogue.zh: 手機玻璃是殺手，試試觸控筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A stylus pen, is that in the drawer too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈstaɪləs pɛn ɪz ðæt ɪn ðə drɔr tu/
dialogue.zh: 觸控筆，也在抽屜裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, blue one, it saves the tips completely.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs blu wʌn ɪt seɪvz ðə tɪps kəmˈplitli/
dialogue.zh: 對，藍色那支，能完整保住指尖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saving tips, what about the gym, do I stop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈseɪvɪŋ tɪps wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə dʒɪm du aɪ stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 保住指尖，那健身房要不要停？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lifting bars crack gel, wear padded gloves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪftɪŋ bɑrz kræk dʒɛl wɛr ˈpædəd ɡlʌvz/
dialogue.zh: 舉槓會裂凝膠，要戴有墊的手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Padded gloves I own, so the gym is safe?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpædəd ɡlʌvz aɪ oʊn soʊ ðə dʒɪm ɪz seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 有墊手套我有，所以健身房沒問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe enough, and wipe sweat off the tips.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf ɪˈnʌf ænd waɪp swɛt ɔf ðə tɪps/
dialogue.zh: 夠安全，然後把指尖的汗擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweat off tips, does sweat hurt the set?
dialogue.phonetic: /swɛt ɔf tɪps dʊz swɛt hɜrt ðə sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 擦指尖的汗，汗水會傷這組美甲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweat is oily, it loosens the lifted edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɛt ɪz ˈɔɪli ɪt ˈlusənz ðə ˈlɪftɪd ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 汗帶油，會讓翹起的邊更鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oily hands, I need to wash them more often.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔɪli hændz aɪ nid tə wɑʃ ðɛm mɔr ˈɔfən/
dialogue.zh: 我手偏油，得洗得更頻繁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Washing is fine, but dry them fully each time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑʃɪŋ ɪz faɪn bʌt draɪ ðɛm ˈfʊli itʃ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 洗沒問題，但每次都要完全擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fully dry, air or towel, which one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʊli draɪ ɛr ɔr ˈtaʊəl wɪtʃ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 完全擦乾，用風還是用毛巾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Towel pat, rubbing drags gel at the edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaʊəl pæt ˈrʌbɪŋ dræɡz dʒɛl æt ði ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 毛巾輕輕壓，來回擦會把邊上的膠拖掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pat, not rub, I will practice that today.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæt nɑt rʌb aɪ wɪl ˈpræktɪs ðæt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是壓不是擦，我今天開始練。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Practice pays, a rubbed edge lifts in days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpræktɪs peɪz ə ˈrʌbd ɛdʒ lɪfts ɪn deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 練習有回報，擦過的邊幾天就翹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Days, weeks, when do I come back for sure?
dialogue.phonetic: /deɪz wikz wɛn du aɪ kʌm bæk fɚ ʃʊr/
dialogue.zh: 幾天幾週都算，我到底何時回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three weeks, or the day one corner lifts.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri wikz ɔr ðə deɪ wʌn ˈkɔrnɚ lɪfts/
dialogue.zh: 三週，或哪天有個角翹起來就回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lifted corner, I should not pull it, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪftɪd ˈkɔrnɚ aɪ ʃʊd nɑt pʊl ɪt raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 角翹起來，我不該拉它，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never pull, it takes the plate with it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər pʊl ɪt teɪks ðə pleɪt wɪð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 絕對別拉，它會連甲面一起帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Takes the plate, that sounds painful and slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪks ðə pleɪt ðæt saʊndz ˈpeɪnfəl ænd sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 連甲面一起帶走，聽起來又痛又慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It heals in weeks, if you leave it alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hilz ɪn wikz ɪf ju liv ɪt əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 只要不碰它，幾週就長好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leaving it alone is my hardest skill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlivɪŋ ɪt əˈloʊn ɪz maɪ ˈhɑrdəst skɪl/
dialogue.zh: 不去碰它，是我最難的技巧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, so I keep hands busy during gel.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu soʊ aɪ kip hændz ˈbɪzi ˈdʊrɪŋ dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 我也一樣，所以烤膠時讓手忙著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Busy hands forget to pick, clever design.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪzi hændz fɚˈɡɛt tə pɪk ˈklɛvɚ dɪˈzaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 手一忙就忘了摳，這安排聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Design aside, the gel itself needs dry air.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈzaɪn əˈsaɪd ðə dʒɛl ɪtˈsɛlf nidz draɪ ɛr/
dialogue.zh: 先不說安排，凝膠本身需要乾空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry air, is humidity the enemy of gel?
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ɛr ɪz hjuˈmɪdəti ði ˈɛnəmi ʌv dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 乾空氣，濕氣是凝膠的敵人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Humidity slows drying, the gel still sticks.
dialogue.phonetic: /hjuˈmɪdəti sloʊz ˈdraɪɪŋ ðə dʒɛl stɪl stɪks/
dialogue.zh: 濕氣會讓它乾得慢，但還是黏得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sticks anyway, good, I live in a wet city.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪks ˈɛniˌweɪ ɡʊd aɪ lɪv ɪn ə wɛt ˈsɪti/
dialogue.zh: 還是黏得住，太好了，我住在很濕的城市。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet cities need longer cures, I set ninety.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt ˈsɪtiz nid ˈlɔŋɡɚ kjʊrz aɪ sɛt ˈnaɪnti/
dialogue.zh: 潮濕城市要烤久一點，我設九十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety instead of sixty, that is a fix.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti ɪnˈstɛd ʌv ˈsɪksti ðæt ɪz ə fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 九十秒取代六十秒，這是解法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small fix, your city air is heavy today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl fɪks jʊr ˈsɪti ɛr ɪz ˈhɛvi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 小調整而已，今天你城市的空氣很悶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy air, so polish bubbles in summer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi ɛr soʊ ˈpɑlɪʃ ˈbʌbəlz ɪn ˈsʌmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 空氣悶，所以夏天指甲油會起泡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bubbles happen, thin coats let air escape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌbəlz ˈhæpən θɪn koʊts lɛt ɛr ɪkˈsep/
dialogue.zh: 會起泡，薄塗能讓空氣跑出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let air escape, that is why you go thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɛr ɪkˈsɛp ðæt ɪz waɪ ju ɡoʊ θɪn/
dialogue.zh: 讓空氣跑掉，所以你每層都薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, thick coats trap bubbles and wrinkle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli θɪk koʊts træp ˈbʌbəlz ænd ˈwɪŋkəl/
dialogue.zh: 對，厚層會關住氣泡還會皺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrinkle plus bubbles, my last set had both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪŋkəl plʌs ˈbʌbəlz maɪ læst sɛt hæd boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 又皺又起泡，我上組兩個都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where? Show me, I want to see the marks.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃoʊ mi aɪ wɑnt tə si ðə mɑrks/
dialogue.zh: 哪裡？給我看，我想看那些痕跡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here on the thumb, tiny lines near the edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɑn ðə θʌm ˈtaɪni laɪnz nɪr ði ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 拇指這邊，靠近邊角有細細的紋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see them, that set dried too slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ðɛm ðæt sɛt draɪd tu ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 我看到了，那組乾得太慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dried too slowly, so the lamp was too weak?
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪd tu ˈsloʊli soʊ ðə læmp wʊz tu wik/
dialogue.zh: 乾得太慢，是燈不夠強嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old bulbs lose power, mine are brand new.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld bʌlz luz ˈpaʊər maɪn ɑr brænd nu/
dialogue.zh: 舊燈泡會掉功率，我這盞是新換的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brand new bulbs, that explains the smooth set.
dialogue.phonetic: /brænd nu bʌlz ðæt ɪkˈspleɪnz ðə smuð sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 全新燈泡，難怪這組這麼平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smooth sets need fresh bulbs and fresh gel.
dialogue.phonetic: /smuð sɛts nid frɛʃ bʌlz ænd frɛʃ dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 要平，就需要新燈泡和新凝膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How old is the gel you used on me?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ oʊld ɪz ðə dʒɛl ju juzd ɑn mi/
dialogue.zh: 你塗我這瓶凝膠開多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Opened Monday, so it is four days young.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpənd ˈmʌndeɪ soʊ ɪt ɪz fɔr deɪz jʌŋ/
dialogue.zh: 週一開的，所以才四天新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four days young, that is why it flows well.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr deɪz jʌŋ ðæt ɪz waɪ ɪt floʊz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 才四天新，難怪這麼好推。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old gel gets stringy, then edges lift fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld dʒɛl ɡɛts ˈstrɪŋi ðɛn ˈɛdʒɪz lɪft fæst/
dialogue.zh: 舊凝膠會拉絲，然後邊角很快翹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stringy gel, I felt that at my last salon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstrɪŋi dʒɛl aɪ fɛlt ðæt æt maɪ læst səˈlɑn/
dialogue.zh: 拉絲的凝膠，上家美甲店我就碰到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She stretched it too far, poor bottle, poor nails.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi strɛtʃt ɪt tu fɑr pʊr ˈbɑtəl pʊr neɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 她把膠拉太長，可憐那瓶，可憐你的甲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Poor nails, so I looked for a new place.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊr neɪlz soʊ aɪ lʊkt fɚ ə nu pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 可憐我的指甲，所以我就換店了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome, your nails look better now honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm jʊr neɪlz lʊk ˈbɛtɚ naʊ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎，說真的，你的甲現在好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better now, I stopped using the drugstore remover.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtɚ naʊ aɪ stɑpt jʊˈzɪŋ ðə ˈdrʌɡˌstɔr rɪˈmulvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好多了，我不再用藥妝店的卸甲水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Removers with acetone strip the plate dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmulvɚz wɪð ˈæsəˌton strɪp ðə pleɪt draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 含丙酮的卸甲水會把甲面擦到乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry plates crack, so I use oil now nightly.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ pleɪts kræk soʊ aɪ juz ɔɪl naʊ ˈnaɪtli/
dialogue.zh: 乾了的甲面會裂，所以我現在每晚上油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nightly oil is the cheapest nail treatment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪtli ɔɪl ɪz ðə ˈtʃipɪst neɪl ˈtritmənt/
dialogue.zh: 每晚擦油是最便宜的護甲方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheapest treatment, I can afford eight dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃipɪst ˈtritmənt aɪ kæn əˈfɔrd eɪt ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 最便宜的方式，八美元我付得起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight well spent, your cuticles will thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt wɛl spɛnt jʊr ˈkjutɪkəlz wɪl θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 那八美元花得值，你的甲皮會謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank them nightly, and what if this chips early?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ðɛm ˈnaɪtli ænd wʌt ɪf ðɪs tʃɪps ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 每晚謝謝它們，那如果這次很快掉呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come within seven days, we fix it free.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm wɪˈðɪn ˈsɛvən deɪz wi fɪks ɪt fri/
dialogue.zh: 七天內回來，我們免費幫你修。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free fix within seven days, that is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri fɪks wɪˈðɪn ˈsɛvən deɪz ðæt ɪz fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 七天內免費修，這很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair policy, I write the date on your card.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ˈpɑləsi aɪ raɪt ðə deɪt ɑn jʊr kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 公道的規矩，我會把日期寫在你的卡上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On my card, so no receipt is needed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn maɪ kɑrd soʊ noʊ rɪˈsit ɪz ˈnidɪd/
dialogue.zh: 寫在我的卡上，那就不用收據了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No receipt, your face is the warranty here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rɪˈsit jʊr feɪs ɪz ðə ˈwɔrənti hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 不用收據，在這裡你的臉就是保固。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The face warranty, I will remember that line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə feɪs ˈwɔrənti aɪ wɪl rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðæt laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 臉就是保固，這句我會記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Repeat it to friends, that pays my rent.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈpit ɪt tə frɛndz ðæt peɪz maɪ rɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 跟朋友唸這句話，那能付我的房租。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your rent depends on my friends and my nails.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr rɛnt dɪˈpɛndz ɑn maɪ frɛndz ænd maɪ neɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 你的房租竟然連到我的指甲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, so I do not rush the second coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli soʊ aɪ du nɑt rʌʃ ðə ˈsɛkənd koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，所以我第二層從不趕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rushing shows, my last set had bald spots.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrʌʃɪŋ ʃoʊz maɪ læst sɛt hæd bɔld spɑts/
dialogue.zh: 趕就會露出來，我上組有禿的塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bald spots mean the brush ran dry mid stroke.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɔld spɑts min ðə brʌʃ ræn draɪ mɪd stroʊk/
dialogue.zh: 禿塊代表筆刷畫到一半沒油了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mid stroke, so reload the brush often here?
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪd stroʊk soʊ rɪˈloʊd ðə brʌʃ ˈɔfən hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 畫到一半，所以你常重新沾膠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Often, cheap gel, rich look, that is the trade.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔfən tʃip dʒɛl rɪtʃ lʊk ðæt ɪz ðə treɪd/
dialogue.zh: 常常沾，膠用得不貴，顏色飽滿，這是交換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rich look worth a little extra gel, sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪtʃ lʊk wɜrθ ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɛkstrə dʒɛl ʃʊr/
dialogue.zh: 顏色飽滿值得多用一點膠，當然。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One bottle covers six hands, I count it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈbɑtəl ˈkʌvərz sɪks hændz aɪ kaʊnt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一瓶能塗六雙手，這些我都算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six hands per bottle, your math is better.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks hændz pɚ ˈbɑtəl jʊr mæθ ɪz ˈbɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一瓶六雙手，你的數學比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I count everything, gel, hours, and clean towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kaʊnt ˈɛvriθɪŋ dʒɛl ˈaʊərz ænd klin ˈtaʊəlz/
dialogue.zh: 我什麼都算，凝膠、時數、還有乾淨毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Counting gel, how many shades do you own?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkaʊntɪŋ dʒɛl haʊ ˈmɛni ʃeɪdz du ju oʊn/
dialogue.zh: 數著凝膠，你總共有多少色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three hundred, and the reds are my weakness.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈhʌndrəd ænd ðə rɛdz ɑr maɪ ˈwiknɪs/
dialogue.zh: 三百色，紅色系是我的弱點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three hundred shades, the chart book holds them?
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈhʌndrəd ʃeɪdz ðə tʃɑrt bʊk hoʊldz ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 三百色，色卡本都裝得下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most of them, some live in the back drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ʌv ðɛm sʌm lɪv ɪn ðə bæk drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 大部分在裡面，有一些裝在後面的抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drawer shades, bring one next time, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /drɔr ʃeɪdz brɪŋ wʌn nɛkst taɪm pliz/
dialogue.zh: 抽屜裡的那些色，下次拿一條給我好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, I will photo the new ones for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil aɪ wɪl ˈfoʊtoʊ ðə nu wʌnz fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 好，我拍新色照片傳給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos of shades, then I text you my choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊz ʌv ʃeɪdz ðɛn aɪ tɛkst ju maɪ tʃɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 拍色卡照片，然後我回你選哪個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text anytime, now breathe, the seal is set.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ˈɛniˌtaɪm naʊ brið ðə sil ɪz sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 隨時傳，現在深呼吸，封層已經定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outside is windy, did the door slam hard?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ɪz ˈwɪndi dɪd ðə dɔr slæm hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 外面風好大，剛開門被風用力摔了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does all day, the wind carries dust in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz ɔl deɪ ðə wɪnd ˈkæriz dʌst ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 整天都在吹，風把塵土帶進店內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dust on wet gel is a disaster, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌst ɑn wɛt dʒɛl ɪz ə dɪˈzæstər ˈtruli/
dialogue.zh: 塵土落在濕凝膠上就是災難，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I work fast and keep the door shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɜrk fæst ænd kip ðə dɔr ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 所以我動作快，門也關著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart, the wind here feels stronger than outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ðə wɪnd hɪr filz ˈstrɔŋɡɚ ðæn ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，這裡面的風感覺比外面還強。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fan adds it, it clears polish fumes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn ædz ɪt ɪt klɪrz ˈpɑlɪʃ fjumz/
dialogue.zh: 是小風扇加的，它要排掉指甲油的氣味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fumes and wind, my nails smell like nothing now.
dialogue.phonetic: /fjumz ænd wɪnd maɪ neɪlz smɛl laɪk ˈnʌθɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 氣味加風，我的指甲現在完全沒味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that means the top coat sealed tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðæt minz ðə tɑp koʊt sild taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 很好，那代表封層已經封死了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold outside, my fingers were icy at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˌaʊtˈsaɪd maɪ ˈfɪŋɡɚz wɝ ˈaɪsi æt ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 外面好冷，我進門時手指像冰塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Icy nails make gel thick and hard to spread.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaɪsi neɪlz meɪk dʒɛl θɪk ænd hɑrd tə sprɛd/
dialogue.zh: 冰指甲會讓凝膠變稠，很難抹開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thick gel, so warming my hands first helps?
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪk dʒɛl soʊ ˈwɔrmɪŋ maɪ hændz fɜrst hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 變稠的話，先把手暖起來有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the soak bowl and the chair pad.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə soʊk boʊl ænd ðə tʃɛr pæd/
dialogue.zh: 有，泡手碗和椅墊都是這作用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pad is warm, someone left a lamp on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pæd ɪz wɔrm ˈsʌmwʌn lɛft ə læmp ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 墊子是溫的，有人開了盞燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I warm two lamps, the cold ones cure slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɔrm tu læmpz ðə koʊld wʌnz kjʊr sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我會先熱兩盞烤燈，冷的燈乾得慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold lamps cure slow, that is new to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld læmpz kjʊr sloʊ ðæt ɪz nu tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 冷的燈乾得慢，這我是第一次聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Winter rooms get cold, so I watch the timer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪntɛr rumz ɡɛt koʊld soʊ aɪ wɑtʃ ðə ˈtaɪmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 冬天的室內會變冷，所以我要盯計時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Winter suits dark colors, my brick red fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪntɛr suts dɑrk ˈkʌlɚz maɪ brɪk rɛd fɪts/
dialogue.zh: 冬天適合深色，我的磚紅剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dark shades hide winter stains on the tips.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrk ʃeɪdz haɪd ˈwɪntɛr steɪnz ɑn ðə tɪps/
dialogue.zh: 深色能蓋掉指尖上的冬天污漬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stains, like coffee? I drink it while typing.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪnz laɪk ˈkɔfi aɪ drɪŋk ɪt waɪl ˈtaɪpɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 污漬像咖啡嗎？我打字時都喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee is fine, the gel does not drink it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi ɪz faɪn ðə dʒɛl dʊz nɑt drɪŋk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡沒關係，凝膠不會把它吸進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A relief, I spill coffee on everything daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɪˈlif aɪ spɪl ˈkɔfi ɑn ˈɛvriθɪŋ ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 鬆了口氣，我每天都會把咖啡潑到東西上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then dark colors forgive your mornings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn dɑrk ˈkʌlɚz fɚˈɡiv jʊr ˈmɔrnɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 那深色會原諒你的早晨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mornings here are rainy, is that a problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋz hɪr ɑr ˈreɪni ɪz ðæt ə ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的早上都在下雨，會有問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain means damp cuffs, they rub your edges.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn minz dæmp kʌfs ðeɪ rʌb jʊr ˈɛdʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 下雨代表袖口是濕的，會磨到你的甲邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Damp cuffs rub edges, I will push my sleeves.
dialogue.phonetic: /dæmp kʌfs rʌb ˈɛdʒɪz aɪ wɪl pʊʃ maɪ slivz/
dialogue.zh: 濕袖口會磨邊，我把袖子推高一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push them up, wet wool smells near gel.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðɛm ʌp wɛt wʊl smɛlz nɪr dʒɛl/
dialogue.zh: 推上去吧，濕毛料在凝膠旁邊會很臭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet wool and gel, a strange mix of smells.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt wʊl ænd dʒɛl ə streɪndʒ mɪks ʌv smɛlz/
dialogue.zh: 濕毛料加凝膠，氣味的組合很怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fan hides it, that is its whole job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn haɪdz ɪt ðæt ɪz ɪts hoʊl dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 風扇會蓋掉，那就是它全部的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its job, and the humidity today is high?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts dʒɑb ænd ðə hjuˈmɪdəti təˈdeɪ ɪz haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 它的工作，那今天的濕度是不是很高？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seventy percent, polish gets tacky in that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvənti pɚˈsɛnt ˈpɑlɪʃ ɡɛts ˈtæki ɪn ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 七十%，那個濕度指甲油會發黏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tacky means sticky, so my coat feels soft?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtæki minz ˈstɪki soʊ maɪ koʊt filz sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 發黏就是黏黏的，所以我這層摸起來軟？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft now, it hardens when the room dries out.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft naʊ ɪt ˈhɑrdənz wɛn ðə rum draɪz aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 現在是軟的，房間乾了它就變硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room drying out, so open a window at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /rum ˈdraɪɪŋ aʊt soʊ ˈoʊpən ə ˈwɪndoʊ æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 房間要乾，那在家該開窗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the air is dry, pollen floats in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ði ɛr ɪz draɪ ˈpɑlən floʊts ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 只有空氣乾的時候開，花粉會飄進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pollen on fresh gel, that would be awful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑlən ɑn frɛʃ dʒɛl ðæt wʊd bi ˈɔfəl/
dialogue.zh: 花粉落在剛好的凝膠上，那很糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tiny grains stuck in the shine, yes awful.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪni ɡreɪnz stʌk ɪn ðə ʃaɪn jɛs ˈɔfəl/
dialogue.zh: 小顆粒卡進光亮裡，是很糟沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awful, and how is the weather inside here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔfəl ænd haʊ ɪz ðə ˈwɛðɚ ɪnˈsaɪd hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 好糟，那店裡面的天氣怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stable, the lamps keep this table warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsteɪbl ðə læmpz kip ðɪs ˈteɪbəl wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 很穩定，烤燈讓這張桌子都是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm table, cold hands, the perfect trade.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ˈteɪbəl koʊld hændz ðə ˈpɜrfɪkt treɪd/
dialogue.zh: 桌子是溫的，手是冷的，完美的交換。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trade accepted, your nails do not shiver.
dialogue.phonetic: /treɪd ɪkˈsɛptɪd jʊr neɪlz du nɑt ˈʃɪvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 成交，你的指甲不會抖就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shivering nails would ruin the brush line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃɪvərɪŋ neɪlz wʊd ruˈɪn ðə brʌʃ laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 發抖的指甲會毀了筆刷畫的線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ruined lines are why I dry hands first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ruˈɪnd laɪnz ɑr waɪ aɪ draɪ hændz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 會毀線，所以我先把手擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Getting dark outside already, is that a problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɛtɪŋ dɑrk ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ɔlˈrɛdi ɪz ðæt ə ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 外面已經要黑了，這有影響嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, but daylight shows the true red.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm bʌt ˈdeɪˌlaɪt ʃoʊz ðə tru rɛd/
dialogue.zh: 沒影響，但日光才看得準真正的紅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The true red needs daylight, I will check tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tru rɛd nidz ˈdeɪˌlaɪt aɪ wɪl tʃɛk təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 真正的紅需要日光，我明天再看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check at the window, then text me a photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk æt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ðɛn tɛkst mi ə ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 在窗邊看，然後拍張照片傳給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A photo, and if the sun fades the color?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ænd ɪf ðə sʌn feɪdz ðə ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 拍照，那如果太陽把顏色曬淡了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sun fades nudes fastest, brick holds longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌn feɪdz nudz ˈfæstɪst brɪk hoʊldz ˈlɔŋɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太陽最快退掉裸色，磚紅撐得久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So summer sun will not kill this brick red?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈsʌmɚ sʌn wɪl nɑt kɪl ðɪs brɪk rɛd/
dialogue.zh: 所以夏天的太陽不會毀了這個磚紅？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunlight dulls it slowly, gloves help outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌlaɪt dʌlz ɪt ˈsloʊli ɡlʌvz hɛlp ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 日光會讓它慢慢變暗，戴手套有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gloves in summer, that looks strange on buses.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlʌvz ɪn ˈsʌmɚ ðæt lʊks streɪndʒ ɑn ˈbʌsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 夏天戴手套，在公車上看起來很怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thin cotton ones, they look like just sleeves.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn ˈkɑtn wʌnz ðeɪ lʊk laɪk dʒʌst slivz/
dialogue.zh: 薄棉的那種，看起來就像袖子的延長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cotton hand sleeves, I will try that once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑtn hænd slivz aɪ wɪl traɪ ðæt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 棉質的手袖，我願意試一次看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try and tell me, my hands need them too.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ænd tɛl mi maɪ hændz nid ðɛm tu/
dialogue.zh: 試了告訴我，我的手也需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your hands crack too, from all the soaking water?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr hændz kræk tu frʌm ɔl ðə ˈsoʊkɪŋ ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你的手也會裂？都是因為每天泡的水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every winter, gloves and oil are my fix.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈwɪntɛr ɡlʌvz ænd ɔɪl ɑr maɪ fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 每年冬天都是，手套和護手油是解方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same fix then, we trade weather tips here.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm fɪks ðɛn wi treɪd ˈwɛðɚ tɪps hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 解方一模一樣，我們在店裡交換天氣招數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trading is good, clients teach me tricks too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtreɪdɪŋ ɪz ɡʊd ˈklaɪənts titʃ mi trɪks tu/
dialogue.zh: 交換很好，客人也教我招數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like the rain trick, I drive with windows closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðə reɪn trɪk aɪ draɪv wɪð ˈwɪndoʊz kloʊzd/
dialogue.zh: 比如雨天那招，我開車都關窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closed windows keep dust off your fresh set.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd ˈwɪndoʊz kip dʌst ɔf jʊr frɛʃ sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 關窗能把塵土擋在你的新甲外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fresh sets hate road dust, that I learned hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ sɛts heɪt roʊd dʌst ðæt aɪ lɜrnd hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 新做的指甲最恨路面灰，這我用損失學到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Learned hard, we all lost a coat to dust.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɜrnd hɑrd wi ɔl lɔst ə koʊt tə dʌst/
dialogue.zh: 用損失學到的，大家都曾因灰塵毀了一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Storms here in spring, does the power flicker?
dialogue.phonetic: /stɔrmz hɪr ɪn sprɪŋ dʊz ðə ˈpaʊər ˈflɪkɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這裡春天常有雷雨，會跳電嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, then I finish with the hand file.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz ðɛn aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ wɪð ðə hænd faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 有時會，那我就用挫條收尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand file without the lamp, is that possible?
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd faɪl wɪˈðaʊt ðə læmp ɪz ðæt ˈpɑsəbl/
dialogue.zh: 沒有烤燈只用挫條，這可行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Air dry polish works, regular gel does not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛr draɪ ˈpɑlɪʃ wɜrks ˈrɛɡjəlɚ dʒɛl dʊz nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 風乾指甲油可以，凝膠就不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a blackout means plain polish only?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə ˈblækˌaʊt minz pleɪn ˈpɑlɪʃ ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 所以停電就只能塗一般指甲油？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a battery lamp saves the whole day.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ə ˈbætəri læmp seɪvz ðə hoʊl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不，我有一支電池小燈能救整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Battery lamp, clever, storms make me jump.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbætəri læmp ˈklɛvɚ stɔrmz meɪk mi dʒʌmp/
dialogue.zh: 電池燈真聰明，一打雷我就會嚇一跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thunder makes people jump, I keep the brush low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθʌndɚ meɪks ˈpipəl dʒʌmp aɪ kip ðə brʌʃ loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 打雷會讓人跳，所以我把筆壓低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thunder while my hand is in the lamp, scary.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθʌndɚ waɪl maɪ hænd ɪz ɪn ðə læmp ˈskɛri/
dialogue.zh: 手在燈裡時打雷，真的很嚇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jumping pulls the hand out fast, no harm done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒʌmpɪŋ pʊlz ðə hænd aʊt fæst noʊ hɑrm dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 一嚇手會抽出，但沒有傷到膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No harm, the cure just starts again slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hɑrm ðə kjʊr dʒʌst stɑrts əˈɡɛn ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 沒傷到，只是烤的進度重新慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, thirty extra seconds, all good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ˈθɜrti ˈɛkstrə ˈsɛkəndz ɔl ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，多烤三十秒就好，全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my nails survive weather and storms both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd maɪ neɪlz sɚˈvaɪv ˈwɛðɚ ænd stɔrmz boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我的指甲能撐過天氣和雷雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Surviving nails need one thing, no picking.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɚˈvaɪvɪŋ neɪlz nid wʌn θɪŋ noʊ ˈpɪkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 能撐住的指甲只需要一件事，不要摳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing, I hear that daily from everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪŋ aɪ hɪr ðæt ˈdeɪli frʌm ˈɛvriˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 就這一件，我每天聽到每個人都在說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone says it, few hands actually listen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn sɛz ɪt fju hændz ˈæktʃuəli ˈlɪsən/
dialogue.zh: 人人都會說，但真的聽進去的手很少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listening hands, I will be one of those hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsənɪŋ hændz aɪ wɪl bi wʌn ʌv ðoz hændz/
dialogue.zh: 會聽話的手，我要當其中一隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, then your gel outlives the weather news.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil ðɛn jʊr dʒɛl aʊtˈlaɪvz ðə ˈwɛðɚ nuz/
dialogue.zh: 好，那你的凝膠會比天氣新聞撐得久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weather news, tomorrow cold again, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛðɚ nuz təˈmɑroʊ koʊld əˈɡɛn raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 天氣新聞說明天又降溫，是吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Colder, so I will turn the soak water warmer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkoʊldɛr soʊ aɪ wɪl tɜrn ðə soʊk ˈwɔtɚ ˈwɔrmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 會更冷，所以泡手水我要調熱一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warmer soak, that makes cuticles give up fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔrmɚ soʊk ðæt meɪks ˈkjutɪkəlz ɡiv ʌp fæst/
dialogue.zh: 水泡熱一點，死皮就很快就投降。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give up gently, no rushing the nipper today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡiv ʌp ˈdʒɛntli noʊ ˈrʌʃɪŋ ðə ˈnɪpɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 投降也要溫柔，今天修甲刀不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No rushing, I love the slow winter pace here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈrʌʃɪŋ aɪ lʌv ðə sloʊ ˈwɪntɛr peɪs hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 不用趕，我喜歡店裡冬天的慢步調。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Winter is slow, summer is five bookings deep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪntɛr ɪz sloʊ ˈsʌmɚ ɪz faɪv ˈbʊkɪŋz dip/
dialogue.zh: 冬天慢，夏天預約都排五輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five bookings deep, the polish goes on faster?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈbʊkɪŋz dip ðə ˈpɑlɪʃ ɡoʊz ɑn ˈfæstɚ/
dialogue.zh: 排五輪，那指甲油就塗得比較急？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Faster hands, thinner coats, that is summer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæstɚ hændz ˈθɪnɚ koʊts ðæt ɪz ˈsʌmɚ/
dialogue.zh: 手比較快，每層比較薄，這就是夏天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thin summer coats chip sooner, I guess.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn ˈsʌmɚ koʊts tʃɪp ˈsunɪk aɪ ɡɛs/
dialogue.zh: 夏天層薄，掉得比較早，我猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You guess right, summer gel lasts two weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɛs raɪt ˈsʌmɚ dʒɛl læsts tu wikz/
dialogue.zh: 你猜對了，夏天凝膠撐兩週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks, still better than regular polish.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wikz stɪl ˈbɛtɚ ðæn ˈrɛɡjəlɚ ˈpɑlɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 兩週，還是比一般指甲油好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better, sweat does not cut the shine.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌtʃ ˈbɛtɚ swɛt dʊz nɑt kʌt ðə ʃaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好很多，汗水不會把光亮切掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shine survives sweat, that is my beach test.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃaɪn sɚˈvaɪvz swɛt ðæt ɪz maɪ bitʃ tɛst/
dialogue.zh: 光亮能扛汗，那是我海邊的測試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beach sand scratches the top coat, careful there.
dialogue.phonetic: /bitʃ sænd ˈskrætʃɪz ðə tɑp koʊt ˈkɛrfəl ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 海灘的沙會刮傷封層，在那邊要小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sand scratches gel? I thought only keys did.
dialogue.phonetic: /sænd ˈskrætʃɪz dʒɛl aɪ θɔt ˈoʊnli kiz dɪd/
dialogue.zh: 沙會刮凝膠？我以為只有鑰匙會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sand, gravel, anything rough dulls the gloss.
dialogue.phonetic: /sænd ˈɡrævəl ˈɛniθɪŋ rʌf dʌlz ðə ɡlɑs/
dialogue.zh: 沙子、碎石，任何粗的東西都會讓亮面變暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dulled gloss I can fix at home, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌld ɡlɑs aɪ kæn fɪks æt hoʊm raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 亮面變暗我在家就能修，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buffer gently, then oil, no need for lamps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌfɚ ˈdʒɛntli ðɛn ɔɪl noʊ nid fɔr læmpz/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕拋光，再上油，不用烤燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weather, gel, and gloves, I learned a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛðɚ dʒɛl ænd ɡlʌvz aɪ lɜrnd ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 天氣、凝膠、手套，我今天學到很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You paid attention, now let us finish the tips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju peɪd əˈtɛnʃən naʊ lɛt ʌz ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə tɪps/
dialogue.zh: 你有專心，現在我們把指尖收尾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last tip sealed, back under the lamp?
dialogue.phonetic: /læst tɪp sild bæk ˈʌndɚ ðə læmp?/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個指尖封好了，再放回烤燈底下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten seconds more, then it beeps twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈsɛkəndz mɔr ðɛn ɪt bips twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 再十秒，然後它會嗶兩聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beeps twice means the gel is hard?
dialogue.phonetic: /bips twaɪs minz ðə dʒɛl ɪz hɑrd?/
dialogue.zh: 嗶兩聲就代表凝膠變硬了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hard on top, still warm inside a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑrd ɑn tɑp stɪl wɔrm ɪnˈsaɪd ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 表面硬了，裡面還有一點溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm inside, so no squeezing anything now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ɪnˈsaɪd soʊ noʊ ˈskwizɪŋ ˈɛniθɪŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 裡面還溫，所以現在別捏任何東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing for two minutes, hands in the air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ fɔr tu ˈmɪnɪts hændz ɪn ði ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘內什麼都別碰，手舉高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hands in the air, that feels so silly.
dialogue.phonetic: /hændz ɪn ði ɛr ðæt filz soʊ ˈsɪli./
dialogue.zh: 手舉高，這樣感覺好傻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone walks like that at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn wɔks laɪk ðæt æt ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 做到最後，每個人都是這樣走的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: While they dry, do I need cold water?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪl ðeɪ draɪ du aɪ nid koʊld ˈwɔtɚ?/
dialogue.zh: 等它們乾的時候，我要泡冷水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you chose regular polish, not gel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ju tʃoʊz ˈrɛɡjəlɚ ˈpɑlɪʃ nɑt dʒɛl./
dialogue.zh: 選一般指甲油才要泡，凝膠不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, gel saves me the icy bowl trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd dʒɛl seɪvz mi ði ˈaɪsi boʊl trɪk./
dialogue.zh: 真好，凝膠讓我省掉冰水那一招。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bowl water still helps when I do my own.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊl ˈwɔtɚ stɪl hɛlps wɛn aɪ du maɪ oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 自己做的時候，泡冷水還是有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your own nails are done at home, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr oʊn neɪlz ɑr dʌn æt hoʊm ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那你自己的指甲都在家做？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weekends only, and always a crooked left thumb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwikˌɛndz ˈoʊnli ænd ˈɔlweɪz ə ˈkrʊkɪd lɛft θʌm./
dialogue.zh: 只有週末，而且左手拇指一定塗歪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crooked thumb, does yours point left or right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrʊkɪd θʌm dʌz jʊrz pɔɪnt lɛft ɔr raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 塗歪的拇指，你的往左還是往右？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left always, and today yours are perfectly straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft ˈɔlweɪz ænd təˈdeɪ jʊrz ɑr ˈpɜrfɪktli streɪt./
dialogue.zh: 永遠往左，不過今天你的十根很直。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfectly straight, and the bump is gone too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪktli streɪt ænd ðə bʌmp ɪz ɡɔn tu?/
dialogue.zh: 很直，那個小凸起也弄掉了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gone, I filed it smooth while you were chatting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɔn aɪ faɪld ɪt smuð waɪl ju wɜr ˈtʃætɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 弄掉了，剛剛你聊天的時候我就磨平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smooth is good, do we add oil now?
dialogue.phonetic: /smuð ɪz ɡʊd du wi æd ɔɪl naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 摸起來很滑，現在要上油嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two drops each, rub it in for a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu drɑps itʃ rʌb ɪt ɪn fɔr ə ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 每根兩滴，搓進去，搓一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rubbing it in stops the dry skin, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrʌbɪŋ ɪt ɪn stɑps ðə draɪ skɪn raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 搓進去就不會乾裂，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, dry skin is where peeling always starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt draɪ skɪn ɪz wɛr ˈpilɪŋ ˈɔlweɪz stɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 對，脫皮都是從乾皮膚開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peeling starts with dry skin, I will remember that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpilɪŋ stɑrts wɪð draɪ skɪn aɪ wɪl rɪˈmɛmbɚ ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 脫皮從乾皮膚開始，我記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oil twice daily, that is the whole secret.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔɪl twaɪs ˈdeɪli ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl ˈsɪkrət./
dialogue.zh: 一天上油兩次，這就是全部的祕訣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whole secret, and it costs me how much?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊl ˈsɪkrət ænd ɪt kɔsts mi haʊ mʌtʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 全部的祕訣，那這瓶油多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight dollars here, or bring any bottle you own.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈdɑlərz hɪr ɔr brɪŋ ˈɛni ˈbɑtəl ju oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 店裡賣八美元，或者自備你家有的瓶子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have one, it lives inside my winter bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv wʌn ɪt lɪvz ɪnˈsaɪd maɪ ˈwɪntɛr bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我有一瓶，一直放在我的冬包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then use yours, the oil here stays for guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn juz jʊrz ði ɔɪl hɪr steɪz fɔr ɡɛsts./
dialogue.zh: 那就用你那瓶，店裡的油留給客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For guests, fine, let us look in the mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ɡɛsts faɪn lɛt ʌz lʊk ɪn ðə ˈmɪrər./
dialogue.zh: 留給客人也好，我們照鏡子看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both hands flat, thumbs up, that is the pose.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ hændz flæt θʌmz ʌp ðæt ɪz ðə poʊz./
dialogue.zh: 兩手放平，拇指朝上，就是這個姿勢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That pose shows every edge, no hiding spots.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt poʊz ʃoʊz ˈɛvri ɛdʒ noʊ ˈhaɪdɪŋ spɑts./
dialogue.zh: 這個姿勢把每個邊都露出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The edges look clean, and the shine looks even.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛdʒɪz lʊk klin ænd ðə ʃaɪn lʊks ˈivən./
dialogue.zh: 邊緣很乾淨，光澤也均勻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even shine, same color on all ten nails?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ʃaɪn seɪm ˈkʌlər ɑn ɔl tɛn neɪlz?/
dialogue.zh: 光澤均勻，十根顏色都一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All ten, plus two thin coats on the thumbs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl tɛn plʌs tu θɪn koʊts ɑn ðə θʌmz./
dialogue.zh: 十根都一樣，拇指另外多塗兩層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thumbs get the most wear, that makes sense.
dialogue.phonetic: /θʌmz ɡɛt ðə moʊst wɛr ðæt meɪks sɛns./
dialogue.zh: 拇指最費，這樣說得通。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most wear, so most care, same rule every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst wɛr soʊ moʊst kɛr seɪm rul ˈɛvri taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 最費就最要小心，每次都是這個道理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every time, and this shade was the right call.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri taɪm ænd ðɪs ʃeɪd wʌz ðə raɪt kɔl./
dialogue.zh: 每次都是，這個色號選對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You picked it fast, and it matches your coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju pɪkt ɪt fæst ænd ɪt ˈmætʃəz jʊr koʊt./
dialogue.zh: 你挑得很快，而且跟你的外套很配。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Matches my coat, exactly what I wanted.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmætʃəz maɪ koʊt ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt aɪ ˈwɑntɪd./
dialogue.zh: 跟外套很配，正是我想要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What you wanted, and nothing added at the chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ju ˈwɑntɪd ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈædɪd æt ðə tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 正是你要的，座位上沒加別的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing added, no length, just plain color.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈædɪd noʊ lɛŋθ dʒʌst pleɪn ˈkʌlɚ./
dialogue.zh: 什麼都沒加，沒有接長，就是素色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain color is the hardest one to do well.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪn ˈkʌlɚ ɪz ðə ˈhɑrdəst wʌn tu du wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 素色才是最難塗好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hardest to do well, so I appreciate it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑrdəst tu du wɛl soʊ aɪ əˈpriʃiˌeɪt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 最難塗好，所以我真的很感謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me honestly, did the red feel too warm?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi ˈɑnəstli dɪd ðə rɛd fil tu wɔrm?/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這個紅會不會太暖？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too warm, no, it looks soft in daylight.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wɔrm noʊ ɪt lʊks sɔft ɪn ˈdeɪˌlaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不會太暖，日光下看起來很柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Daylight is the real test, lamps lie a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdeɪˌlaɪt ɪz ðə ril tɛst læmpz laɪ ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 日光才是真的考驗，烤燈很會騙人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lamps lie, noted, now I need my receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /læmpz laɪ ˈnoʊtɪd naʊ aɪ nid maɪ rɪˈsit./
dialogue.zh: 燈會騙人，記下了，現在我要收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Receipt first, or do you want the total now?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈsit fɜrst ɔr du ju wɑnt ðə ˈtoʊtəl naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 先開收據，還是先報總價？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Total first, please, I like to hear it aloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊtəl fɜrst pliz aɪ laɪk tu hɪr ɪt əˈlaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 先報總價，我想親耳聽見數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty for the gel, and nothing else today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti fɔr ðə dʒɛl ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 凝膠四十，今天沒有別的要加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty flat, nothing for the soak or oil?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti flæt ˈnʌθɪŋ fɔr ðə soʊk ɔr ɔɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 一共四十，那泡卸和油都不另外算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Included, and you used your own bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈkludɪd ænd ju juzd jʊr oʊn ˈbɑtəl./
dialogue.zh: 都含在裡面，而且你用的是自己那瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Straight bill, nothing hidden, that is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪt bɪl ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈhɪdən ðæt ɪz fɛr./
dialogue.zh: 報價乾淨，沒有藏錢，這樣很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card or cash, both work here today.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd ɔr kæʃ boʊθ wɜrk hɪr təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 刷卡或現金，今天兩種都收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card today, my cash is at home, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑrd təˈdeɪ maɪ kæʃ ɪz æt hoʊm ˈsɑri./
dialogue.zh: 今天刷卡，現金都放家裡了，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry not needed, the machine reads any card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri nɑt ˈnidɪd ðə məˈʃin ridz ˈɛni kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 不用抱歉，機子什麼卡都讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any card, and do I tap it or insert?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni kɑrd ænd du aɪ tæp ɪt ɔr ɪnˈsɜrt?/
dialogue.zh: 什麼卡都讀，那我感應還是插卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap it, then wait for the green light twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ɪt ðɛn weɪt fɔr ðə ɡrin laɪt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 感應就好，然後等綠燈亮兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green twice, done, did that land on your end?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin twaɪs dʌn dɪd ðæt lænd ɑn jʊr ɛnd?/
dialogue.zh: 綠燈兩次，好了，你那邊收到款了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It landed, here is your card and the receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈlændɪd hɪr ɪz jʊr kɑrd ænd ðə rɪˈsit./
dialogue.zh: 收到了，這是你的卡和收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Printed twice? One copy stays in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɪntɪd twaɪs wʌn ˈkɑpi steɪz ɪn maɪ bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 收據印兩份？我要留一份在包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One copy, plus a small card with my dates.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈkɑpi plʌs ə smɔl kɑrd wɪð maɪ deɪts./
dialogue.zh: 一份給你，再加一張寫著我時段的小卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your dates, so tips here go in the jar?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr deɪts soʊ tɪps hɪr ɡoʊ ɪn ðə dʒɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 你的時段，那小費是丟進那個罐子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tips go in the jar, cash, at the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪps ɡoʊ ɪn ðə dʒɑr kæʃ æt ðə ˈkaʊntɚ./
dialogue.zh: 小費放罐子，要現金，在櫃台前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The jar by the door with the painted nails?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɑr baɪ ðə dɔr wɪð ðə ˈpeɪntɪd neɪlz?/
dialogue.zh: 門口那個畫了指甲的罐子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one, but you can tip me by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn bət ju kæn tɪp mi baɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 就是那個，不過你也可以直接給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By hand, good, how much do people usually give?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ hænd ɡʊd haʊ mʌtʃ du ˈpipəl ˈjuʒəwəli ɡɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 直接給最好，大家通常給多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around twenty percent, but take your own time.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd ˈtwɛnti pɚˈsɛnt bət teɪk jʊr oʊn taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 大概兩成，不過你自己慢慢算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty percent, I will round up to ten extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti pɚˈsɛnt aɪ wɪl raʊnd ʌp tu tɛn ˈɛkstrə./
dialogue.zh: 兩成，那我進位多給十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten extra is generous, but tipping is your choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈɛkstrə ɪz ˈdʒɛnɚrəs bət ˈtɪpɪŋ ɪz jʊr tʃɔɪs./
dialogue.zh: 多十塊很大方，不過小費看你自己。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My choice, then here, thank you for the patience.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tʃɔɪs ðɛn hɪr θæŋk ju fɔr ðə ˈpeɪʃəns./
dialogue.zh: 我決定了，給你，謝謝你的耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, and the patience was mostly yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ænd ðə ˈpeɪʃəns wʌz ˈmoʊstli jʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 該謝的是你，耐心大部分是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly mine? I only asked for thinner coats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli maɪn aɪ ˈoʊnli æskt fɔr ˈθɪnɚ koʊts./
dialogue.zh: 大部分是我的？我只是請層塗薄一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Asking keeps the result honest, that matters most.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæskɪŋ kips ðə rɪˈzʌlt ˈɑnəst ðæt ˈmætɚz moʊst./
dialogue.zh: 肯問結果才實在，這點最要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Matters most, and I mean the color too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmætɚz moʊst ænd aɪ min ðə ˈkʌlɚ tu./
dialogue.zh: 最要緊的還有顏色，那也得算你一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The color was yours, I only held the brush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌlɚ wʌz jʊrz aɪ ˈoʊnli hɛld ðə brʌʃ./
dialogue.zh: 顏色是你挑的，我只是拿著筆塗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Held the brush steady through all my questions.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛld ðə brʌʃ ˈstɛdi θru ɔl maɪ ˈkwɛstʃənz./
dialogue.zh: 一路聽我問，筆還是很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Questions are half the service, ask me anytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwɛstʃənz ɑr hæf ðə ˈsɜrvɪs æsk mi ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm./
dialogue.zh: 問題也是服務的一半，隨時問我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anytime, so shall I book the next visit now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm soʊ ʃæl aɪ bʊk ðə nɛkst ˈvɪzɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 隨時能問，那我現在就約下一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now is easiest, my January slots fill quickly.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪz ˈistiest maɪ ˈdʒænjʊˌɛri slɑts fɪl ˈkwɪkli./
dialogue.zh: 現在最好約，我一月的時段很快就滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: January slots, which week is still open?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒænjʊˌɛri slɑts wɪtʃ wik ɪz stɪl ˈoʊpən?/
dialogue.zh: 一月的時段，哪一週還空著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The second Saturday, morning, if that suits you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɪf ðæt suts ju./
dialogue.zh: 第二個週六，早上時段，看你方不方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday morning works, ten or eleven o'clock?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ wɜrks tɛn ɔr ɪˈlɛvən əˈklɑk?/
dialogue.zh: 週六早上可以，十點還是十一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven, and I will keep the window seat free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən ænd aɪ wɪl kip ðə ˈwɪndoʊ sit fri./
dialogue.zh: 十一點，靠窗那個位子我留給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Window seat, that is where the light is best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪndoʊ sit ðæt ɪz wɛr ðə laɪt ɪz bɛst./
dialogue.zh: 靠窗的位子，那邊光線最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best light, and best view of the weather news.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst laɪt ænd bɛst vju ʌv ðə ˈwɛðɚ nuz./
dialogue.zh: 光線最好，看天氣新聞也最方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weather news again, will you still be here then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛðɚ nuz əˈɡɛn wɪl ju stɪl bi hɪr ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 又提到天氣，那個時候你還在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here every Saturday, plus two evenings in a row.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ˈɛvri ˈsætɚˌdeɪ plʌs tu ˈivnɪŋz ɪn ə roʊ./
dialogue.zh: 每個週六都在，另外也排兩個晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In a row, so evenings go fast, noted.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə roʊ soʊ ˈivnɪŋz ɡoʊ fæst ˈnoʊtɪd./
dialogue.zh: 排兩個晚上，所以晚上滿得快，記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Evenings fill faster, so mornings are safer to book.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivnɪŋz fɪl ˈfæstɚ soʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋz ɑr ˈseɪfɚ tu bʊk./
dialogue.zh: 晚上滿得快，所以約早上比較穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Booked, do you text a reminder before that day?
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊkt du ju tɛkst ə rɪˈmaɪndɚ bɪˈfɔr ðæt deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 約好了，事前你會傳提醒訊息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two texts, one the day before, one at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tɛksts wʌn ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔr wʌn æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 會傳兩則，一則在前一天，一則在晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both texts help, do I owe a deposit now?
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ tɛksts hɛlp du aɪ oʊ ə dɪˈpɑzɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 兩則都有用，那我要先付訂金嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No deposit, just phone the day before if needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dɪˈpɑzɪt dʒʌst foʊn ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔr ɪf ˈnidɪd./
dialogue.zh: 不用訂金，要改時間就打來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One day ahead, by call or by text, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn deɪ əˈhɛd baɪ kɔl ɔr baɪ tɛkst ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 提前一天，是打電話還是傳訊息？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text is fine, it reaches me through the snow.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ɪz faɪn ɪt ˈritʃəz mi θru ðə snoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 傳訊息就行，下雪我也收得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snow, gloves, booking, paid, all done at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /snoʊ ɡlʌvz ˈbʊkɪŋ peɪd ɔl dʌn æt læst./
dialogue.zh: 下雪、手套、約好、也結帳，全都做完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All done, and the tips outlived the weather news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl dʌn ænd ðə tɪps ˌaʊtˈlɪvd ðə ˈwɛðɚ nuz./
dialogue.zh: 全做完了，這對指尖撐得過天氣新聞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outlived the news, thank you, see you Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈlɪvd ðə nuz θæŋk ju si ju ˈsætɚˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 撐得過天氣新聞，謝謝你，週六見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you Saturday, hands warm, nails finished, good night.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈsætɚˌdeɪ hændz wɔrm neɪlz ˈfɪnɪʃt ɡʊd naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 週六見，手保持暖，指甲做好了，晚安。
